name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: A Tanúhegyek Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amelyet a Terepfutó Műhely Sportegyesület rendez a Balaton-felvidéki Nemzeti Park egyik legszebb részén, Badacsonytomajban. A verseny során 7, 21 és 42 km-es távokon lehet indulni, amelyek során 1, 3 vagy 5 tanúhegyet lehet meghódítani, csodálatos kilátással a Balatonra és a környező tájra. A rajt és a cél a Halászkertben van, és a verseny jótékonysági céllal is zajlik, az időmérő chip letéti díját az Ürömi Állatotthon javára lehet felajánlani. A legrövidebb távon kutyás futamot is rendeznek, mindenkit szeretettel várnak a 2026. november 14-i eseményre.
course_highlights: Terepfutás a Balaton-felvidéki Nemzeti Parkban
Káprázatos kilátás a Balatonra és az őszi színekben pompázó tájra
Útvonal 1, 3 vagy 5 tanúhegy meghódításával
additional: Időmérés elektronikusan, chip segítségével történik, a chip letéti díja 2000 Ft, amely visszajár vagy jótékony célra felajánlható. A verseny útvonalán előre be nem jelentett ellenőrzőpontok lehetnek. A legrövidebb távon kutyás futamot is rendeznek. A verseny nem zárja le a közutakat, ezért a közlekedési szabályok betartása kötelező. Távok: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; kutyás futam a 7 km-en; jótékonysági esemény az időmérő csip letéti díjával

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is a challenging uphill mountain race in the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route follows a marked hiking trail with steep climbs all the way to the summit of Minčol at an elevation of 1,363 m, where runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. The race is for bold runners who want to test their abilities on a demanding course with little room to rest. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: Marked hiking trail with blue blazes
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Finish at the summit of Minčol, with views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results will be announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. There are refreshments on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish; after the race, lunch is served (homemade kapustnica and a drink). Runners can use a drop bag, which will be transported to the facilities below the ski slope, where the prizes will be presented. The organizers arrange transport of runners’ belongings to the results ceremony venue. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

The race is open to all ages, with no age-group divisions, and is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The start is split into two waves: the longer distance starts at 10:00, and the shorter distances at 11:00. The event is suitable for runners looking for a forest run with a choice of distances and difficulty levels.

Includes country roads and asphalt sections
Three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km
additional: The start is split into two waves: the 22 km race starts at 10:00, and the 5.5 km and 11 km races start at 11:00. The course surface is varied, including forest roads, country roads and asphalt. The race takes place on terrain featuring forest roads, country roads and asphalt. Registration is available online or on site. Categories are available for children, men and women, with a choice of short and long distances.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Az Oxigén Kupa egy téli futóversenysorozat Debrecenben, a Nagyerdőben, amely közép- és hosszútávfutók, valamint amatőr futók számára biztosít versenyzési lehetőséget. A verseny célja a futás és az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése, valamint a versenyzés biztosítása különböző korosztályoknak és kategóriáknak. A versenysorozat hagyományosan a futók téli felkészülését támogatja, és a futóközösség összetartását erősíti a természetes, futóbarát talajú Nagyerdőben.
course_highlights: Futás a Debreceni Nagyerdő futó- és ízületbarát talaján
Több körös pályák 1,5 km-től 10 km-ig különböző korosztályoknak
Parkolási lehetőség a temető melletti parkolóban
additional: A versenysorozatra évente egyszer kell regisztrálni, és a regisztráció érvényes az adott évad összes futamára. A rajtszám elvesztése vagy megrongálódása esetén új rajtszám váltható 2000 Ft-ért. Csapatverseny is van, ahol minimum 4, maximum 8 főből álló csapatok versenyeznek nemre és korra való tekintet nélkül. A versenyek eredményei a sportstopper.hu oldalon érhetők el a verseny másnapján. A 2026/2027-es évad a kupa jubileumi, XX. kiírása. Az évadra egyszer kell regisztrálni; a csapatversenyre 4 - 8 fős csapatok nevezhetnek. A megadott január 23-i forduló részletei az elérhető évadkiírásban nem szerepelnek.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: A Tihany Trail egy téli terepfutó és nordic walking verseny, amely változatos és kemény terepen, a Balaton-felvidék álomszép helyszínein zajlik. A pálya különlegessége, hogy a kaldera peremén, sziklaperemen is futnak a résztvevők, így izgalmas és látványos futásban lehet részük. A versenyen 5, 10 és 15 km-es távokon lehet indulni, a frissítőpontok pedig gondoskodnak a megfelelő hidratálásról és energiáról. A rendezvény igazi terepfutó csemege, amely a téli időszakban is vonzza a futás szerelmeseit.
course_highlights: Változatos és kemény terep a Balaton-felvidék álomszép helyszínein
Futás a kaldera peremén, sziklaperemen, szűk ösvényeken
Frissítőpontok vízzel, energiaitallal, szőlőcukorral és sós pereccel
additional: A rajtcsomag-átvétel 8:00 és 9:50 között zajlik, majd 9:50-kor bemelegítés Piros Gabival. A frissítés két ponton a pályán és a versenyközpontban történik, a frissítőpontokon pohár nem lesz, ezért kulacsot vagy poharat kell hozni. A 15 km-es távon az első frissítő az Erdei Iskolánál (kb. 6,9 km), a második az Apáti templom mellett (kb. 10,3 km). A pályán <i:am> mineral+ energy drink és meggy ízesítésű hipotóniás ital is elérhető. A versenyzőknek terepfutó cipő viselése ajánlott, csúszásgátlóval, az aszfaltcipő nem alkalmas a terepre. A rajt 10:30-kor lesz; a rendezvényközpont a Tihanyi Bencés Iskolában, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. alatt található. A szervezők terepfutó cipőt és szükség esetén csúszásgátlót javasolnak; frissítőpontokon saját pohár vagy kulacs szükséges.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event through the beautiful Strážov Mountains. The 51 km route with 2,600 metres of elevation gain starts and finishes in the village of Uhrovec, birthplace of Ľudovít Štúr, after whom the race is named. The race is demanding, and experience with similar long-distance routes is recommended. There are three aid stations along the course, which follows marked hiking trails throughout, offering beautiful views and historical sites.
course_highlights: 51 km route with 2,600 m of elevation gain
Follows marked hiking trails in the Strážov Mountains
Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, Chata pod Čiernym vrchom and Kajtárov
additional: The participant limit is 200 runners/hikers. Participant check-in takes place the day before the race and on race morning. There are three aid stations along the route. The organiser recommends having completed at least one event with a 50 km route before the start. The course passes through areas inhabited by brown bears and other wildlife. The organiser monitors the weather and may adjust the route or programme in case of danger. The start and finish are at Ľudovít Štúr Square in Uhrovec. Information about mandatory equipment, rules and registration is available on the official website.

name: Letecká stovka
description: Letecká Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain. It takes place in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountains. The start and finish are in Trenčín, and the route runs mainly along marked hiking trails. It is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over; participants aged 17 may also take part if accompanied by a legal guardian.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: ALS charitatívny beh
description: The ALS Charity Run – Ján Svočák Memorial is a mountain trail run in Svit, offering a challenging 21 km course with 950 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest (80%) and meadows (20%), with two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16. Alongside the main race, the event also includes children’s races, relays, Nordic walking and a special trail run with a dog. The event is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with high-quality organisation and a certified course.
course_highlights: 21 km trail with 950 m of elevation gain
80% of the route is through forest and 20% through meadows
Two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16
additional: Individual start times for the trail run with a dog are between 09:30 and 09:40, at 10-second intervals, with each runner’s exact start time printed on their race number. Relays are 3 × 1.7 km with 140 m of elevation gain; the course surface includes forest trail, meadow, asphalt and gravel. Nordic walking takes place on a route that is 90% forest and 10% asphalt. All children’s categories are awarded and results are announced immediately at the finish. ITRA-certified course, 1 qualifying point for ALS 21 km. The event supports people with neuromuscular diseases. Sources differ on the 2027 event date: the listed date is 27 March, while the event website gives 20 March.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

name: Jarný beh Bojničky
description: The Bojničky Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by the Bojničky Athletics Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place in Bojničky in front of the Cultural Centre and is part of the 2026 Nitra Running League. Children, juniors, adults, and Nordic Walking participants can compete, with categories arranged by age and gender. A new feature is a competition for three-person men’s and women’s teams in the 5,000 m Nordic Walking event. Race starts are staggered by category from 9:45 to 12:15.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail is a mountain running race in Divín, offering two challenging courses with beautiful views and significant elevation gain. The race is organized by OZ Ostrôžky and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in nature. The Ostrôšky Ultra course is 47 km long with 2,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter Langoš Trail is 27 km long with 950 m of elevation gain. The race starts in two waves: the longer course starts at 7:30 and the shorter at 9:00.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
location: Kálnica, Kálnica, pred Kultúrnym domom Kálnica
description: The Kálnica Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the Romanian soldiers who fell during the liberation of the village. The race follows a route from Kálnica to Rakoľuby and back, with different distances for different age categories. The course is paved, flat, and includes gentle elevation changes and turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who may run accompanied by an adult. The race starts at the Cultural Center in Kálnica.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Zvolen, Zvolen, Námestie SNP, Fun zóna
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: The Zvolen Corrida is a running event held in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Runners complete five flat 1 km laps, for a total of 5 km. The event also includes children’s races and a free fun run for parents and children. It is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional event organization and timing.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
location: Košice, Košice, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: The Furčiansky Marathon – Štefan Seman Memorial is a traditional running marathon organized by O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. The organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a high-quality, well-organized marathon.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
description: The Spring Run of Michalovce is a traditional running race held on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce, near Primary School No. 5 on Školská Street. Competitors can look forward to races in various age categories, including children under 9, who run 400 meters. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a spring sports day, with results announced and medalists recognized.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto, offering courses for different age groups, including children and adults. The start is in the western part of Murgašova Street. Participants can compete in the 1 km race for children or the 10 km race for adults and juniors. The race is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto and offers categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 10:05, and all other categories start at 10:30. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and supports sporting life in the region.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: The Slovak Republic Marathon Championships for men, women, and masters are a major athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Association. The event is part of a race series and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including masters. Registration is online and open to the wider running community.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
location: Trenčianske Stankovce, Trenčianske Stankovce, futbalové ihrisko
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized in the area around Trenčín since 2015, open to the general public, including competitive runners and enthusiasts. One race takes place each month from March to November on a variety of interesting courses. The events offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and a chance to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. The results and standings after each race provide motivation for further training and improving performance.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. It has grown organically since its first edition in 2018, reaching more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country (11 km), sprint (6 km), and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find the right challenge. The varied courses include trails, dirt roads, and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment stations. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 11 km, sprint 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment stations at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9, and the finish, with water, isotonic drink, and food
additional: The routes may include elevation changes, roots, and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment stations along the routes offer water, isotonic drink, and food.

organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom is a night run organized by the student organization Woodenworld at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Runners complete a 7 km course with 40 metres of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen, passing landmarks such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes for the top finishers and a commemorative item. The start is at 20:30 in front of the Technical University, and the race is suitable for the general public, including university students and staff.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
description: The Friendly Night Run through the City of Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou, offering a nighttime running experience through the city. The race takes place at the Sídlisko II Primary School grounds and is open to men, women, and children. The main category starts at 19:30, and the children’s run begins at 17:00. The organizers—OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Primary School, the City of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry—warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.

name: III. ÁGOTA® Futás – Fuss Értük Szegeden! Jótékonysági futóverseny
organizer: Csongrád-Csanád Vármegyei Kormányhivatal, Szegedi Tudományegyetem, Gál Ferenс Egyetem
description: Az ÁGOTA® Futás egy jótékonysági futóverseny Szegeden, amely a gyermekvédelmi gondoskodásban élő fiatalokat támogatja. A verseny a Dóm térről indul, és városi, forgalomtól elzárt, szilárd burkolatú utcákon halad. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a gyerekfutamoktól a félmaratonig, egy nap a mozgás, a közösség és az odafigyelés jegyében. A nevezési díjakból befolyt összeg fejlesztéseket és élményeket biztosít a támogatott fiatalok számára.

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia is the 40th anniversary edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering a range of disciplines for all age groups. The event is intended not only for athletes, but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotion, the joy of movement and the challenge of surpassing themselves. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, refreshments and drinks; children also receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners receive cash prizes and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginner and advanced runners
A commemorative medal for every participant, including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 on the day of the event and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners do not receive cups, but valuable cut glass. Winners in the special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event includes various disciplines, prizes, refreshments and a cultural programme. Registration is online, and road closures are expected during the races.

name: Malkovský krosový polmaratón – Memoriál Vlada Dančišina
location: Parkovisko pod Furčou, Borkút, Haniska pri Prešove, Slovakia

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a prestigious running event held on April 18, 2026. Runners travel from Košice to Miskolc along a demanding ultramarathon course. The event is part of the region’s rich running calendar and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. It is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice, which ensures professional planning and organization.

name: BoleRuN
location: Boleráz, Boleráz, areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz sports complex, offering races for different age groups, including children, teenagers and adults. Competitors can choose distances from 50 metres to 10 km. The children’s races start at 13:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the Boleráz – Get Moving initiative. It is open to runners aged 9 and over who want to enjoy a day of sport in a pleasant setting.

name: Šarišská míľa
location: Šarišské Bohdanovce, Šarišské Bohdanovce, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Šarišská Mile is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football field. The race is intended for various age groups, including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants. The starts are divided into a children’s mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men. Participation is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution during registration. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages.

name: Chlieb náš….
location: Hronský Beňadik, Hronský Beňadik, pekáreň Dumas
description: Chlieb Náš is an artisan bakery in Hronský Beňadik that makes sourdough bread using traditional methods and quality ingredients. It takes pride in honest baking, reflected in the bread’s crisp crust, lively sourdough starter and soft interior. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread straight from the oven. In addition to the quality of its bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, one of the most original in Trnava.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
location: Turčianska Štiavnička, Turčianska Štiavnička, futbalové ihrisko
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to mark the anniversary of the village’s liberation by the Soviet Army. The 32nd edition will take place on 18 April 2026 at the football field in Turčianska Štiavnička. The approximately 10 km course runs mostly through mountainous terrain and offers runners a challenging but beautiful experience. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the best runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
description: We Run Together in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four routes of different lengths, including a children’s run, suitable for the general public, including children under 6. The route is flat with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with €2 from every entry fee going towards motivating them to be physically active.

name: Polus Tower Run
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1 km
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair-running event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Competitors climb the elevation under their own power on two courses: a children’s course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and the main adult course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Runners start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded using an electronic system. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and conducted under current TWA rules.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: BRAȘOV 21K Run the City. Feel the Mountains.
La Petrovaselo în vie
description: Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances along scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience with well-marked routes and refreshment stations in a friendly, well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, provided upon presentation of their race number.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, along the hiking trails of the Zărand Mountains, between the towns of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the area’s natural and historical heritage, linking the Șoimoș and Șiria fortresses, as well as other points of interest, along the route. The courses offer an adventurous experience with spring scenery and a medieval atmosphere, and are suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars.

name: Vértés Terep Maraton
location: Szár, Sportcsarnok, Forrás utca . Ápr.25.-28. BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM - Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya n*
distance_verbose: 221 km, 50 km, Maraton, 27 km, Félmaraton, 13 km, 10 km, 6.7 km
description: A Vértes Terep Maraton egy kihívásokkal teli terepfutó verseny a Vértes hegység festői ösvényein és erdészeti útjain. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, az ultramaratontól a minimaratonig, mindegyik változatos szintemelkedéssel és jól jelölt pályával. A rendezvény frissítőpontokkal, névre szóló rajtszámmal, időméréssel és gazdag célétellel várja a résztvevőket, akik a természet közelségét és a sportos élményt élvezhetik. A verseny családias hangulatú, és a szervezők külön figyelmet fordítanak a futók kényelmére és biztonságára.

name: Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run
description: A Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run egy közösségépítő, tavaszi futófesztivál Szombathelyen, amely céges, baráti és iskolai csapatok számára kínál különböző távokat egyéni és váltó kategóriákban. A verseny 2,5 km-es gyerekfutamtól indul, és 5 km, 10 km, valamint 20 km-es távokon zajlik, váltókkal kiegészítve. A rendezvény célja a sport és a mozgáskultúra népszerűsítése, egyedi befutóéremmel, elektronikus időméréssel és élő eredménykövetéssel. A versenyhez egészségnap is kapcsolódik, ahol mentálhigiénés szakemberek és terápiás bemutatók várják a résztvevőket. Ingyenes parkolás biztosított a Vasi Skanzen parkolójában.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: A Fuss a struccal jótékonysági futófesztivál Győrben, az Aranyparton kerül megrendezésre 2026-ban immár harmadik alkalommal. A rendezvényen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a legkisebbektől a legidősebbekig minden korosztály számára nyitott. A futófesztivál célja a gyermekellátás támogatása, különösen egy speciális EEG készülék beszerzése az epilepsziás és súlyos állapotú gyermekek diagnosztikájához. A rendezvényen ismert sportolók és közéleti személyiségek is részt vesznek, családias, közösségi hangulatban. A nevezési díjakból befolyt összeg a Gyermek Intenzív Terápiáért Alapítványt támogatja.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton egy hagyományos futóverseny Mosonmagyaróváron, amely a szabadidősport népszerűsítését szolgálja. A verseny az Olimpiai Ötpróba része, és 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, valamint félmaraton (21,1 km) távokon kínál pontszerzési lehetőséget. A rajt és cél az UFM Arénánál van, ahol öltözési, zuhanyzási és ruhatári lehetőségek állnak rendelkezésre. A versenyen chipes időmérés biztosított, és a leghosszabb távon limitidő van érvényben. A rajtszámra a nevezők neve vagy beceneve is rákerülhet, ha április 10-ig neveznek.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of events, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is filled with emotion, fair play and a sense of community, where everyone who takes the start and pushes beyond their limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and emphasizes the value of helping one another and solidarity.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 2.6 km, 1 km
description: TIPOS Devín–Bratislava National Run is Slovakia’s oldest sporting event, with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, and will be held for the 78th time. Runners take on the iconic route from historic Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava, creating a unique atmosphere that brings history and sport together. The event is suitable for recreational athletes and more competitive runners alike, and attracts thousands of participants of all ages every year. It is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava, which provides all organisational information and registration.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
location: Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, pred budovou Zákl. školy v Sačurove

description: Sačurov Fifteen – the 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the Sačurov primary school building and offers categories for various age groups, including children, youth and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, pred budovou Obecného úradu

The event offers three disciplines: a 10 km long run, a 3.66 km short run, and a 3.66 km short Nordic walking event, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming runners of different ages and ability levels. The organizer, MATORE s.r.o., ensures high-quality event organization and timekeeping.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke
description: The Liberation Run for the Likavka Mayor’s Traveling Cup is a traditional race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium in Likavka and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Children, pupils, juniors, women, and men can compete in various age categories. The start for pupils is at 10:05 and for adults at 11:40, according to the race regulations. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a chance to test your strength in the beautiful surroundings of Likavka.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
location: Čadca, Čadca, Čadca sídlisko Žarec (Domov dôchodcov)
description: The Čadca Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysuce Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Čadca Žarec Social Services Centre. The 30th edition will take place on April 19, 2026, starting at 10:00 a.m. in the Žarec residential area of Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is open until April 17, 2026; participants can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running over varied terrain, including forest trails and forest roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked route with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded off with an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch. The start is scheduled for 10:00, following a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor exercise.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on April 21, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. in Trojičné Square in Trnava. Runners will complete a 5-kilometer route through the historic streets of Trnava’s city center, offering the unique atmosphere of “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through exercise and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go toward rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organizers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students, and main partner CUKROVAR.

name: ULTRABALATON
distance_verbose: 221 km, Maraton, 27 km, Félmaraton, 13 km, 10 km
organizer: Balatonman Triatlon Kft & FULLCON IT Development Kft
description: Az Ultrabalaton 2026-ban immár 20. alkalommal kerül megrendezésre, Magyarország legnépszerűbb közösségi sporteseménye. A verseny a Balatont megkerülő egykörös futóverseny, amely Közép-Európa leghosszabb futóversenye, és egyéniben vagy csapatban, futva vagy kerékpárral is teljesíthető. A táv 209 kilométer, amely egyéni indulóknak és 2-6 fős csapatoknak is elérhető. A rendezvény barátságos, közösségi hangulatú, és a futók mellett a kísérők és kerékpárosok számára is vonzó programokat kínál.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
description: A Mozdulj, Csepel! egy ingyenes családi futóverseny, amelyet a Csepeli Önkormányzat szervez az Aktívan Csepelért Programsorozat keretében. A verseny a meseszép csepeli dunaparton, a Kolonics György Szabadidőközpontból indul, és négy távon kínál lehetőséget a mozgásra: 3,5 km, 7 km, 400 m gyerekfutam, valamint egy speciális futam fogyatékkal élők számára. A verseny célja a közösségi élmény és a mozgás örömének megosztása minden korosztály számára, környezettudatos szemlélettel, pohármentes frissítéssel. A rajtszám viselése kötelező a 3,5 km-es és 7 km-es távokon, és chipes időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A VI. Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás 2026. április 25-én kerül megrendezésre Tata, a Tópart sétányon. A verseny két távon, 7 km (1 tókör) és 14 km (2 tókör) teljesítésével várja a futókat, akik korosztályonként és nemenként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, a tóparti környezetben zajlik, és a résztvevők számára egyaránt kihívást és élményt nyújt. A rajt 10:00-kor kezdődik, a nevezés pedig április 23-án 18:00 óráig lehetséges.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
description: A Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 egy különleges ultrafutó verseny, amely az utolsó emberig tart. A versenyzők egy 6706 méteres kört teljesítenek óránként, és csak azok maradnak versenyben, akik a következő rajtig beérnek. A verseny a Hungarian Backyard League része, korosztályos bajnokságként kerül megrendezésre, ahol 11 korosztályban díjazzák a legjobb női és férfi futókat. A verseny helyszíne a Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya Esztergomban, és a résztvevők között akár 160 kilométeres távot is teljesítők is elismerést kapnak.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultrarunning race held on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners the challenge of a long and varied course. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners looking for a unique experience at the limits of their abilities. The race starts on Hlavná Street in Košice, adding a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Cieľ sa nachádza na parkovisku vedľa kina Hviezda v Turni nad Bodvou
description: Ultra Kras is a 57 km mountain ultramarathon with 2,400 metres of elevation gain, running through Slovak Karst National Park. Both the start and finish are in Turňa nad Bodvou, and the race has a 12-hour time limit. It is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League and features a challenging route with several refreshment and checkpoint stations. Race registration takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Liptovský Mikuláš, časť Demänová, Liptovský Mikuláš, časť Demänová, Demänová rezort
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held amid the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The event features three disciplines: the 5 km Malý Štvanec, the 10 km Veľký Štvanec with TUI, and the Štvanček children’s races. Alongside the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family-friendly atmosphere and additional activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games, and fun, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Rača Half Marathon and Rača Ten are traditional running events in the Bratislava-Rača borough, offering participants the choice of a half marathon or a 10K. Runners can enjoy a course through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex and the surrounding parts of Rača. The event is suitable for the general public, including recreational runners and more competitive athletes. It is organised by the Bratislava-Rača borough, which provides quality facilities and services for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex in Bratislava-Rača
Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to Prešov Stars Run 2026, taking place on 25 April in the centre of Prešov. This running evening will immerse you in the atmosphere of the 1990s, with music, retro sportswear and entertainment. Runners can choose from children’s races and 5 km and 10 km courses, accompanied along the way by DJs and a performance by MC Erik. Prešov Stars Run is the first event in the Prešov Running Series 2026, which consists of three separate races in different parts of the city and its surroundings.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
location: Dobrá Niva, Dobrá Niva, Námestie SNP
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobrá Niva, offering various races, including the main race, a fun run, Nordic walking and a Backyard Ultra. The event takes place on 25 April 2026, with registration and starts at SNP Square. It is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, recreational runners and ultramarathon runners, with capacity limited to 400 participants. The organizer is ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., which provides professional event organization and timekeeping.

name: Agrotim Race
location: Zemplínska Nová Ves, Zemplínska Nová Ves, Zemplínsky Klečenov pod altánkom v Oáze oddychu
organizer: Obec Zemplínska Nová Ves a AGROTIM spol. s.r.o
description: Agrotim Race is a running event organized by the Municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o. It takes place in Zemplínsky Klečenov, beneath the gazebo in the Oáza oddychu. The race is open to men and women, with online registration available until April 22, 2025. An early registration discount is available, while registration on the day costs more. The event is suited to runners looking for an enjoyable run in a natural setting.

name: 1000-ročný beh
location: Spišská Nová Ves, Spišská Nová Ves, Tenisové kurty pri nemocnici s poliklinikou v Spišskej Novej Vsi
description: The 1000-Year Run is a running competition organised by SPK Medveď in Spišská Nová Ves. It takes place on 25 April 2026 at the tennis courts near the hospital and polyclinic. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with the main race covering approximately 9.6 km and 267 m of elevation gain. The event also includes categories for children, youth, juniors, Nordic walking and a run for health. The start is at 10:00. Competitors are provided with refreshments along the course and at the finish, including goulash or pierogi and a drink. Registration is available online or by email, and the entry fee is paid on site on race day.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
location: Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, pri Obecnom úrade
description: The Chtelnica Liberation Run is a traditional race with an unchanged route. It starts at 1. mája Square and passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Little Carpathians. The course combines paved sections with a forest path alongside the Chtelnica Reservoir, the World War II memorial, and the Chapel of St. Roch. Runners can enjoy the natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary “steep climb” through the forest. The event is suitable for runners looking for a mix of paved roads and natural terrain in a peaceful mountain setting.

name: Čirov beh – Radobica
location: Radobica okr. Prievidza, Radobica okr. Prievidza, pred obecným úradom
description: Čirov Run - Radobica is a traditional village race, offering runners the chance to enjoy varied terrain on a 5.4 km course with 201 metres of elevation gain. The course runs along asphalt, village streets, field roads, hills, flat sections and through small woods, including a short, steep stretch. The event also includes 800-metre children’s races suitable for younger runners. It takes place in Radobica in front of the municipal office and is open to various age groups, including local runners. The organizers offer cash prizes for breaking course records.

name: Jablonická desiatka
description: The Jablonica Ten is the traditional Felix Rímeš Memorial Run, held in the village of Jablonica. The event is for the whole family, suitable for children, and offers wheelchair access. Runners can enjoy an active way to spend their free time in the pleasant surroundings of the village. The entry fee is nominal, and children and young people can take part for free.

name: NZ charitatívny beh pre OZ čiernouško
location: Nové Zámky, Nové Zámky, parkovisko pri reštaurácii Berek (ulica Tatranská)
organizer: Občianske združenie čiernouško, STG Nové Zámky
description: The NZ Charity Run for the Čiernouško Civic Association is a running event in Nové Zámky, held in the car park by the Berek restaurant on Tatranská Street. The course is mostly asphalt, flat, and off public roads. Proceeds from the run go to the Čiernouško Civic Association, which helps homeless, abused, and otherwise vulnerable animals. The event is organised by the Čiernouško Civic Association and STG Nové Zámky, and is suitable for animal lovers and runners who want to combine sport with charitable support.

name: Sereďský Horalky beh
description: The Seredský HORALKY Run 2026 is a running competition held in the beautiful surroundings of the Castle Park in Sereď. The race offers runners of different age groups and abilities the chance to enjoy a day of sport in nature. The course winds through the scenic park and surrounding countryside, making for an enjoyable experience for all participants. The organizers welcome all runners and sports fans to this traditional event.

name: Night run Nitra
organizer: Občianske združenie Šport a zdravie, Big-agency Slovakia, Mesto Nitra
description: Nitra Night Run 2026 is a popular night running event held in the city centre of Nitra. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, and the programme also includes 5 km Nordic Walking. The event offers a sporting atmosphere filled with music and energy, while children’s runs are free and do not require registration. The day is packed with sporting activities, culminating in an evening run with a mass start at Svätopluk Square.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.

name: Alergăraș în Făgăraș

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Preț standard până la termenul limită

tiers.description: Preț standard până la termenul limită

description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sporting and charitable event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event on April 25, 2026, aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race, all held along the Someș Promenade, with the start and finish near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds raised through registration fees go directly to the charitable project.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The 5th edition of Maratonul Codrului is an event organized by Club Sportiv Pro Racers and the Romanian Cycling Federation, taking place on April 25, 2026, at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition for both amateurs and professionals, featuring MTB and Trail Run events on spectacular forest trails, with challenges for all levels. The event offers new and more challenging MTB routes, as well as hobby events with shorter routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants receive a start pack, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, a pasta party, and finisher medals.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București is an untimed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start wearing white and are covered in colored powder at every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the finish. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas, offering a festive experience accessible to all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, with special moments such as a cloud of colored powder and live music.

name: Forest Race Marghita
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail-running competition of moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by Run For Freedom Sports Club together with XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four different routes tailored to various levels of runners. The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are well marked along forest roads. The competition promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 100 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

location: Planinarski dom Železničar, Fruška Gora, Serbia
