name: Beh Gáňom
location: Gáň, okr. Galanta, Gáň, okr. Galanta, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Beh Gáňom is a running event held in the village of Gáň, Galanta District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race offers categories for children, adults and seniors, including the main race and the health run. Starts are scheduled for the children’s categories at 9:00, the health run at 9:45 and the main race at 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public, including village residents, who receive a discounted entry fee. The organizer is Tomáš Mrva, who also provides contact information for interested participants.

name: VEREDA Night Run
location: Považská Bystrica, Okres Považská Bystrica, Trenčiansky kraj
organizer: VEREDA sport a OZ Dobrý pohyb
description: VEREDA Night Run is a night race in Považská Bystrica offering an 8 km course, with the option to compete in relay teams (2 x 4 km). The race is open to individuals, pairs, children, and corporate teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is organized by VEREDA sport and OZ Dobrý pohyb with the support of the city of Považská Bystrica and is known for its atmosphere and community spirit. The start is by the fountain near Kino Mier, with the children’s run starting at 17:00 and the main races at 20:30.

name: Strachan run
description: Strachan Run 2026 at Strednica is the second edition of the trail race, held in the picturesque Goral village of Ždiar beneath the Belianske Tatras. Runners can look forward to an unforgettable sporting experience in the surroundings of Strachankovo Family Park and Ski Centre Strednica. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sport in one. The organizers invite all runners to this appealing event with a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh revúckym chotárom – Memoriál Tomáša Kubeja
location: ZŠ J. A. Komenského, Revúca, Slovakia

name: O putovný pohár starostu obce Vlachy
location: Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Kultúrny dom Vlachy
description: The Race for the Mayor of Vlachy’s Challenge Cup is a running race with a 6,900-metre course and 150 metres of elevation gain. The race takes place at the cultural centre in Vlachy, in the Liptovský Mikuláš District. This traditional running event attracts runners from the surrounding area and offers a challenge in the form of a gentle uphill section. The organizers warmly welcome all runners who want to test themselves in the beautiful setting of the village of Vlachy.

name: RETRO Night Run
organizer: Športové centrum RETRO sport & wellness, SPORT RETRO, s.r.o.
description: RETRO Night Run is a running event in Bratislava offering a night run with various categories for children and adults. The race takes place at OC RETRO on Nevädzová Street and is organized by the RETRO sport & wellness sports center. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes. The children’s races start at 16:00 and the main races at 20:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a night run in the city.

name: Detva behá, tak sa pridaj!
description: Detva Runs, So Join In! is a traditional running race in Detva, offering courses for both children and adults. The event takes place on May 16, 2026, at 4th J.J. Thurza Primary School and includes the main Hobby (6.2 km) and Main (10.7 km) courses, on forest roads and asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public, including various age groups, and features children’s races, for which no entry fee is required. Organized by ŠK Detva v pohybe, the event creates a friendly atmosphere and welcomes all runners and families.

name: Beh Jednoty
location: Nové Zámky, Nové Zámky, Hlavné námestie
description: Beh Jednoty 2026 in Nové Zámky is an event for everyone—from active athletes to families with children. The program includes children’s races divided by age group and a main 5-kilometer run through the town, suitable for recreational and more competitive runners. Activities for children, refreshments, and a raffle will be available throughout the day. By taking part, you will support the local community and a good cause, combining sport with helping others.

name: Behaj lesmi – Beckov
location: Beckov, Okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Trenčiansky kraj
description: Behaj lesmi Beckov is part of a series of seven races held in beautiful Slovak nature, offering routes mostly on soft terrain and fresh air. Runners can enjoy an unforgettable day beneath Beckov Castle, with support from the castle guard and views of the surrounding countryside. The routes pass through Beckov’s mysterious corners and are accompanied by legends, making the run an energetic adventure. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, adding to its international significance and appeal for trail runners.

name: Babindolský májový kros
location: Babindol (okes Nitra), Babindol (okes Nitra), futbalové ihrisko
description: Babindol May Cross-Country Run is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all ages, held amid the beautiful May countryside of the Lower Nitra region in the village of Babindol. The race offers two main courses of 8 km and 16 km, running mainly along farm roads and forest trails with moderate elevation gain. The event also includes a children’s course around the football field, an accompanying program, goulash for runners, and prizes for the winners in each category. It is organized by the Municipality of Babindol in cooperation with Zdeno Zamboj, with the start traditionally at 10:00 at the football field in Babindol.

name: Nočný beh Hlohovcom
description: The Night Run through Hlohovec is a popular night race taking place on May 16, 2026, in the Castle Park in Hlohovec. Runners can enjoy an attractive 6 km loop through the park’s picturesque surroundings, with its pond and the largest plane tree grove in Central Europe, along the Váh River, through the town center, and past Hlohovec’s main landmarks. The event offers categories for children, a main race, and Nordic walking, with the start in front of the amphitheater in the Castle Garden. The organizers emphasize safety and recommend reflective accessories and headlamps. Finisher medals are prepared for the first 550 participants.

name: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026
description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is a 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is untimed, focusing on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of colors applied at every kilometer. The urban route starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple successive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a leading mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The competition includes Marathon, Half Marathon and Cross Country races, as well as a children’s race, EcoKids. The courses are made up of 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic running experience in nature, with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a trail running event held on marked paths in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a spectacular natural setting and a challenge for all fitness levels. The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced athletes to those seeking a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering facilities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. It’s an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: The Suceava Citadels Cross-Country Run is a popular running event held in the city of Suceava, offering participants an outdoor sporting experience with routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels. The event includes children’s races, a popular race, and a cross-country race, promoting exercise and community spirit. Participants can run along routes passing through historic and picturesque areas, surrounded by citadels and local scenery. The organizers provide a participation kit and prizes for competitors, encouraging involvement and athletic performance.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills is a mountain running race held in Crasna, Sălaj County, on May 16, 2026. The event invites running enthusiasts to explore the area's scenic hills, offering a sporting experience in nature. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy beautiful scenery and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer 21 km red course with 1,400 meters of elevation gain for seniors, and a shorter 10 km blue course with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The routes pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race brings together competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series follows the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

name: 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás
description: A 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás Magyarország egyik legszebb és legikonikusabb futóversenye, amely 11,6 km-es távon 671 méter szintemelkedéssel vezet fel Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, a Kékes csúcsára. A verseny a Mátra lenyűgöző természeti környezetében zajlik, ahol több ezer futóval együtt élheted át ezt az egyedülálló kihívást. A célban egyedi érem várja a résztvevőket, hogy örökre emlékezetes maradjon ez a nap. A verseny nemcsak fizikai erőpróba, hanem egy igazi kaland és élmény is, amelyre mindenkit szeretettel várnak.

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS TRAIL
description: A Kékes Csúcsfutás egy ikonikus és kihívásokkal teli futóverseny Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, Kékestetőre. A verseny 11,6 km hosszú, 671 méter szintemelkedéssel, gyönyörű természeti környezetben, a Mátra panorámájával. A résztvevők egyedülálló élményben részesülnek, miközben a hegyre vezető folyamatosan emelkedő út próbára teszi kitartásukat. A versenyen egyedi éremmel jutalmazzák a célba érkezőket, és lehetőség van jótékonykodásra is a nevezés során.

name: Vertikál Martinky
organizer: Fatra Outdoor Team a Winter Park Martinky
description: Vertikál Martinky is the fourth edition of a demanding uphill race and part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Runners can earn ITRA Score points and compete against the best on an extreme course with 944 metres of elevation gain. The event offers a challenge for both professional and recreational runners in the beautiful surroundings of Martinky. It also includes children’s categories with shorter courses and parental accompaniment. The organizers provide transport for personal belongings to the finish, refreshments and free parking.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
location: Tovarné okr. Vranov, Tovarné okr. Vranov, pred budovou Obecného úradu
description: The Thanksgiving Run – Tovarné – František Chmeľ Memorial is a running event organized by the municipality of Tovarné in Vranov nad Topľou District. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné and is open to runners across a wide range of age and gender categories. The event has a long-standing tradition and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories for men and women. The organizers provide participants with complete information and support.

name: Beh Zabudišovou
location: Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová (otoč)
description: The Zabudišová Run is a running event held in the village of Zabudišová, Nové Mesto nad Váhom District. It offers a 5,400-metre course with scenic views and 133 metres of elevation gain. The route combines asphalt, gravel and grassy paths. The event also includes fun races for children in various age groups. After the race, participants can enjoy game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners. Runners take part at their own risk. Online registration is available, with a participant limit, and children run for free.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Target minim donații Participă Target 1.200 RON

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: SEMIMARATONUL SIRETULUI In memoriam Ilie Roșu
location: Adjudu Vechi, Adjud, Vrancea County, Romania

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition testing strength, speed, agility, and skills, held at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition, scheduled for May 17, 2026, challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.

name: Crosul Sport4All
description: Sport 4 All Cross-Country Run is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. The event features untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The routes are loops around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places provided by sponsor Mondial S.A.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is Romania’s largest cross-country cycling marathon, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, covering approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no major elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere—ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, with a new course passing through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together a large number of runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with particular attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has nurtured Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

name: Hegyre Megyek - Badacsonyi Futófesztivál 500m / 4 km / 8 km / 11 km / 21 km
LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: A Lélekfutás és Piknik egy szeretetteljes közösségi esemény Magyarpolányban, amely a test és lélek mozgásáról, feltöltődéséről szól. A futóversenyen kicsik és nagyok egyaránt részt vesznek, majd a napot finom ételek és meditatív programok, például labirintusjárás és gongos hangfürdő teszik teljessé. Ez az esemény nem csupán sport, hanem egy élő, lélegző közösségi ünnep, amely a természet ölelésében zajlik. A rendezvényt a Habitus Alapítvány szervezi, és a Polányi Pünkösdi rendezvénysorozat részeként kerül megrendezésre.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: A Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón - štafety egy váltóverseny Salgótarján és Lučenec között, amely 42,2 km-es távot ölel fel hat szakaszban, 4-6 fős csapatok számára. A verseny útvonala festői településeken halad át, és a futók a teljes távot váltva teljesítik. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, frissítőpontokkal és a célban gulyással várja a résztvevőket, miközben kulturális programok is színesítik a napot. A verseny 2025. augusztus 23-án kerül megrendezésre, és a nevezés augusztus 20-ig online lehetséges, később csak helyszíni regisztrációval, ha van még hely.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: A Salomon Twin Peaks Trail egy 22 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely a Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary része. A pálya a Dömös és Szentfa-Kápolna környékén vezet, és magában foglalja a híres "két tüskét", amelyek különleges kihívást jelentenek a futóknak. Ez a verseny egyedülálló célbaérés élményt kínál Magyarországon, amelyet csak az UTH adhat meg. A verseny ideális azoknak, akik szeretnének belekóstolni az Ultra-Trail Hungary hangulatába és terepfutó kihívásaiba.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: A Salomon Visegrád Trail egy 30 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely az egykori visegrádi római őrtoronytól indul és a szentendrei belvárosig vezet. A futók a Visegrádi-hegység legszebb és legnehezebben járható részein haladnak át, változatos és kihívást jelentő terepen. A verseny a természet szerelmeseinek és a terepfutás rajongóinak egyaránt felejthetetlen élményt nyújt. A rendezvény hagyományosan magas színvonalú, és a résztvevők számára jól szervezett támogatást biztosítanak a pálya mentén.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field in the village of Trstín, Trnava District. The course runs mainly along field and grassy paths, with a short section on an asphalt footpath. Men, women, juniors and residents of Trstín compete in different age categories, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.
course_highlights: Three quarters of the course is on field and grassy paths
One quarter of the course is on an asphalt footpath
The race takes place at the football field in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender; some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Trstín Municipality, tel. 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk; Mayor Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes several categories and is part of the Spring Health Run. On-site registration is also possible. Registration is available by contacting the organizers.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Beh is a charity race taking place on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá-Dulice. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes through gently undulating terrain on dirt roads and gravel, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain. The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards treatment for a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there will be entertainment for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows dirt roads and gravel
Gently undulating terrain with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Belá-Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant will receive a drink, a fitness bar and a gift from the partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available to purchase. Every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. Professional entertainers and attractions will be available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of dirt roads and asphalt. Changing rooms, showers and refreshments are available on site. Registration is available online, with a virtual participation option.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Trenčín, Trenčín, Klub Lúč – Mierové námestie 17
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at Klub Lúč and, weather permitting, on Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city at night. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on race day if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
location: Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Farma pod Vtáčnikom
distance_verbose: 50 km, 27 km, 24 km, 10 km, 8.4 km, 5 km
description: The Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race in the area around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose from a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has its own time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments available at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.

name: Petržalská 10
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
location: Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Hlavné námestie
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay marathon held on May 23, 2026, along a route between Salgótarján, Hungary, and Lučenec, Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with a minimum ratio of 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the route, and goulash, sports cups, and cash prizes await the best relay teams at the finish. The race starts at 10:00. Registration is open until May 21, 2026, online or on site if places are still available.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
location: Hlboké nad Váhom, Hlboké nad Váhom, Areál pri futbalovom ihrisku
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features a single-lap course with plenty of adrenaline-pumping obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air and challenges on the course, followed by awards, refreshments, and keepsakes.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. The event offers two courses: the main 22 km race and an 8 km hobby run, both along asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km run at 10:15. The event is suitable for various age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.

name: Kostolanský májovec
location: Veľké Kostoľany, Veľké Kostoľany, futbalový štadión
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses, 10.90 km and 5.40 km long, both with 64 meters of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for a pleasant run with moderate elevation gain in a beautiful setting.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer the lively atmosphere of a quality sporting event.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
location: Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Kaplnka sv. Huberta
description: The Run Under Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and a chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The route passes through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
location: Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, futbalový štadión
description: The Ant Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The races offer categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as for children, school-age participants, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which provides a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.

name: Niže Linča
location: Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Vinohrady Zeleneč
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč
description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women, and juniors under 18, with prizes also awarded to the fastest local man and woman. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban festivities, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration opens on April 13, 2026, and the race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with stunning views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The course is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail that suits their skills and preferences.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Ul. Pod záhradami (pri Lidli)
description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava offering races for children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka district, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu Vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka District Municipality. The race is suitable for the general public and offers categories by age and gender.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charity running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Čierne, at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia, and Poland. The event offers six different courses, including a half marathon, a 10K, a 5K, Nordic walking, and children’s races. The courses run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized routes with clear markings, refreshment stations, and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.

name: Hutňanská šelma
location: Novoveská Huta, Novoveská Huta, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for both children and adults. The races take place in the pleasant setting of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and are divided into several age categories, with awards for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: Bârlad Hills Challenge ~ 2027
location: Cotu Negru, Bârlad, Vaslui County, Romania

name: Jidvei Weinland Trails - Running Edition ~ 2027
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The competition combines running and cycling on scenic routes through the Jidvei vineyards, offering participants spectacular views and an authentic experience surrounded by nature. The event includes races for all fitness levels, from children to adults, as well as recreational and food-and-wine activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bucovina, offering spectacular courses and a festival atmosphere beneath the stars. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, involves the local community, and supports the education of underprivileged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from a half marathon to children’s races, and enjoy an authentic nature experience with hydration stations, a hot meal, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly, environmentally responsible atmosphere.

name: Tour de Tur
description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the Lake Mujdeni area, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers a variety of routes for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, and is dedicated to both professional athletes and amateurs who love nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked routes and significant elevation changes, set in picturesque natural surroundings. The organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the event’s competitive, friendly atmosphere.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This anniversary 21st race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in men’s and women’s divisions as well as by age group. Participants receive chip-timed race bibs and “Joma” Dry Fit shirts, while the organizer provides transportation and a formal dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. Special highlights include the Golija PREMIUM race, which starts at the summit of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K, a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being entered into the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and togetherness through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we’re running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, aiming to become part of a new attempt at a Guinness World Record for the first time in Serbia.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2.5 km, 1.7 km, 1500 meter, 0.85 km, 0.8 km, 0.3 km
description: A Salomon Szentendre Trail egy 54 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely Szentendrén és környékén zajlik, 1800 méter szintemelkedéssel. A futók átkelnek tizenkétszer az Apátkúti-patakon, és a verseny során gyönyörű tájakon, köztük Visegrádon és a Kálvárián haladnak át. A cél Szentendre főterén és a Duna korzón van, ahol a turisták tapsolnak a befutóknak. Ez a verseny egyedülálló élményt nyújt a természet és a városi környezet találkozásával.

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
description: A Salomon Szentlászló Trail egy izgalmas terepfutó verseny Szentendrén, amely a Visegrádi-hegység legmeredekebb emelkedőit kínálja. A verseny hajnalban indul, és a résztvevők a gomolygó párás Sikárosi-réten futnak át, miközben a kakukk köszönti őket. A célba érkezés előtt még a turisták tapsolása is várja a futókat a sétálóutcákon és a Főtéren. Ez a kihívás a természet szerelmeseinek és a terepfutás rajongóinak egyaránt felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a more informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and follow the boundary between the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross, which lets them run with their dog.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over natural terrain, such as farm tracks, meadows and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three refreshment stations on the longer courses and clearly marked routes. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category receiving awards.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Casa Bună Sânpetru Half Marathon is a charity sporting event that gives participants the opportunity to run on varied and scenic routes in the Sânpetru area of Brașov. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, flawless organization, and support for disadvantaged families through Casa Bună Sânpetru. The routes offer different levels of difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful scenery and sporting challenges. Taking part in this half marathon means not only enjoying a sporting experience, but also supporting a noble cause.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age groups, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed competitive races for the older groups. It’s a race full of energy and joy, with parents cheering on the children. Every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: A BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup egy nemzetközi ultrafutó verseny, amely Balatonfüreden, a Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu területén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több időtartamú futamra oszlik, köztük 72, 48, 24, 12 és 6 órás futamokra, amelyek a Central European Ultra Series részeként zajlanak. A pálya egy 898 méteres kör, minimális, 1 méteres szintemelkedéssel, így ideális a hosszútávú futók számára. A versenyzők egyéni és csapat kategóriákban is indulhatnak, és minden résztvevő emlékérmet kap. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a versenyközpontban központi frissítőasztal áll rendelkezésre.

name: Ružindolský víchor
location: Ružindol okr. Trnava, Ružindol okr. Trnava, športový areál Ružindol
description: Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the Ružindol sports complex. The course runs on asphalt and dirt roads through the village and includes a grass loop around the stadium. Runners can choose between a 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race number, a timing chip, refreshments and a participant medal.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: A V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik és Tömegsport Hétvége 2026. május 30-31-én kerül megrendezésre Sarudon, a Tisza-tó partján. Ez a rendezvény egy közösségi sportesemény, amely a mozgás örömét és a természet közelségét kínálja a résztvevőknek. A programok között különféle sportesemények és családi programok is szerepelnek, így minden korosztály számára élményt nyújt. A helyszín a Tisza-tó gyönyörű környezete, amely ideális a kikapcsolódásra és aktív pihenésre.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: A Hegyen-Völgyön futás egy terepfutó verseny, amely Tardos festői focipályáján kerül megrendezésre. A Sprint Futóklub szervezésében zajló esemény a természet közelségét és a változatos terepet kínálja a futás szerelmeseinek. A verseny a sport és a mozgás örömét hivatott népszerűsíteni, minden aktív életet kedvelőt szeretettel várnak. A szervezők fenntartják az időpont és programváltoztatás jogát.

name: HEGYEN-VÖLGYÖN FUTÁS
description: A Hegyen-Völgyön Futás egy hagyományos, sportkedvelők számára szervezett futóverseny Tardoson, amelyet a Sprint Futóklub rendez. A verseny három különböző távon kínál kihívást: 200 méteres gyerekfutás, valamint 4 és 12 kilométeres távok a komolyabb futóknak. A rajt a tardosi sportpályáról indul, és a verseny chipes időméréssel zajlik, biztosítva a pontos eredményeket. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és évről évre sok futót vonz a környékről.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
location: Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Dobšinská Ľadová Jaskyňa - parkovisko
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
description: The Saliby Half Marathon, Hornosalibská 10 and Hornosalibská 3 are traditional running events organized by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshment stations and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in special kids’ races. Alongside the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a varied accompanying program featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
location: Šamorín, Okres Dunajská Streda, Trnavský kraj
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Pomlé City Park. It is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km races, with categories for both individuals and relay teams. Runners can compete in various age categories, including veterans aged over 50. Relay teams consist of a maximum of three runners, who may take turns in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Športový areál
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event taking place on 30 May 2026 at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The races run through the village streets and surrounding countryside along paved and dirt roads. The event also includes children’s categories with distances varying by age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. It is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
location: Žilina - Poluvsie, Žilina - Poluvsie, rodný dom Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR
description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running race held in honour of paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross-country race over mixed terrain runs from Žilina–Poluvsie, the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík, to the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and chip timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
location: Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Pred kaštieľom
description: Kurimské pobehaňe is a running event organized by the Aktívna Kurima civic association, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course follows asphalt and dirt roads, with dirt and gravel surfaces. The race is open to a range of age groups, from schoolchildren to veterans, with men and women competing in different age categories. Online registration is available, with different entry fees depending on when you register. A school run for children is also provided. The event is ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable, community-oriented running experience in nature.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, now being held for the 14th year. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes that pass around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, Jazierka lásky, and through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers an unmistakable atmosphere, with views of Rysy and a nighttime finish in the dark. In addition to the adult races, children’s runs and Nordic walking are also on offer. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes leading around Malé Štrbské Pleso and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with beautiful views of the Tatra peaks. The event also includes Turbo TV children’s races, with various distances for everyone from the youngest runners to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere is exceptional, with spectators cheering along the route and runners crossing the finish line after dark, making this run a popular fixture in the season.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
location: určianske Jaseno, určianske Jaseno, Lezecká stena Ovčín
description: Fatranský Vĺčko is an endurance sport for people and dogs, combining hiking and running in the beautiful countryside of Veľká Fatra. The event takes place on May 30, 2026, in Turčianske Jaseno and offers two routes: the longer MID, 44 km long with +2,350 m of elevation gain, and the shorter SHORT, 14 km long with +500 m of elevation gain. You can compete in the dog trekking category (person with a dog) or the trail category (running without a dog). Dogs must remain on a leash or in a harness throughout the route; allowing a dog to roam freely results in disqualification. The organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and SHORT for newcomers or those with less training.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a mix of narrow paths, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for runners passionate about the mountains. The races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.transylvania100k.com/): 2027-05-29 — "Transylvania 100 - 12th edition - May 29th 2027." (was estimated 2027-05-30)

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului is a sporting event dedicated to promoting outdoor activity, mountain running, and a healthy lifestyle, for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a variety of routes, from children’s races to a half marathon, in the authentic natural setting of Teiuș, Alba. It promotes inclusion, fair play, and active community participation, with free entry for all participants. A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
description: Thermal Trail Race is an outdoor running race that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event takes place in Băile 1 Mai, with the start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience amid the natural scenery of the capital of thermal waters. This is the 13th edition of the event, bringing together running and nature enthusiasts in a friendly, active setting.

name: Forest Run
description: Baneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race in Băneasa Forest, Cluj-Napoca, offering an authentic experience in nature. The event includes four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km speed run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run for families. The race is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced, and emphasizes the joy of running in the forest. Organized by a passionate team, the event also offers training plans and group workouts to help participants prepare.
