name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful surroundings of Fruška Gora, in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature, and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It gathers cycling and active holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the tourism potential of Vojvodina.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants on a climb up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The route passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations dotted with numerous caves, including a climb to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership booklet valid for 2026 and suitable hiking equipment.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
description: A V. Kastélykör Flow futóverseny egy családbarát, szabadidős esemény, amely a festői Károlyi kastély és kert környezetében, a Natura 2000 védett területen kerül megrendezésre Füzérradványban. A verseny változatos távokat kínál minden korosztálynak, 5, 10 és 20 km-es felnőtt körökkel, valamint rövidebb gyerek távokkal. A futók a kastélykert híres sétányain haladnak, és kutyával is lehet futni meghatározott szabályok szerint. Az esemény az Ötpróba program része, és a résztvevők számára számos kényelmi szolgáltatás áll rendelkezésre, mint csomagmegőrzés, öltözősátor és mosdó.

name: Zsámbékfutás 5 / 10 / 21
description: A Zsámbékfutás egy családbarát futóverseny, amely három távon kínál lehetőséget: 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21,2 km). A verseny útvonala Zsámbék és Tök településeken halad, aszfaltos és murvás útburkolaton, a félmaraton második fele pedig terepfutás a Nyakas-hegy környékén. A pálya változatos, szép kilátásokkal és több frissítőponttal várja a résztvevőket. A rendezvény célja, hogy mindenki megtalálja a számára megfelelő távot, miközben élvezheti a Zsámbéki-medence természeti szépségeit.

name: SÜLYSÁPI FUTÓNAP
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 3.7 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 0.3 km

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Run Around Rajec Square is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and surroundings of Rajec on a May day. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizers emphasize safety and thorough preparation for participants.

name: Beh na Zniev
location: Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, areál bývalého Prvého slovenského gymnázia
description: Beh na Zniev is a championship uphill race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging 5,650-metre course with 475 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the grounds of the former grammar school. The organizers are the Kláštor pod Znievom Municipal Office, Strive sport, TRIMAT and the Slovak Athletics Association. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš
description: The Brewery-Castle Seven-Thousander is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with Šariš Brewery and the Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš grounds and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for the run and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including adolescents, juniors, and women and men in various age categories.

name: Beh rajeckým rínkom
location: Rajec, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km loop race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s memorial house and runs through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past woodland streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then continues across Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethno complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish is located. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: The charity IT race “Štafeta srcem” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. This event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, stay active, and contribute to the community in the beautiful surroundings of the fortress.

name: Ederics VAD szíve - max pulzus 2026
distance_verbose: 30 km, 27 km, 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
description: A XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre Győrben, a Tulipános Általános Iskolánál. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, köztük gyerekfutam, 7, 14 és 21 km-es egyéni futás, 3 fős félmaraton váltó, valamint 7 km-es Nordic Walking. A verseny egyedi befutóérmet, chipes időmérést, frissítést és orvosi ügyeletet biztosít, a pályák jól jelöltek és rendőri biztosítással ellátottak. A rajtcsomag a hosszabb távokon indulóknak jár, és a nevezés előzetes regisztrációval, banki utalással válik véglegessé.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
description: A Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton egy hagyományos, éjszakai futóverseny Győrben, amely több távon kínál lehetőséget a futás szerelmeseinek, beleértve a gyerekfutamot, egyéni távokat és váltókat is. A verseny központja a Tulipános Általános Iskola, és a rendezvény jól szervezett, chipes időméréssel, frissítési pontokkal, orvosi ügyelettel és rendőri biztosítással várja a résztvevőket. A nevezők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak, és a 14 és 21 km-es távokon rajtcsomagot is biztosítanak. A verseny célja, hogy minden korosztály számára élvezetes és biztonságos futóélményt nyújtson.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
description: A Bükki Hegyi Maraton-Kisgyörgy Ádám Emlékverseny Magyarország legrégebbi terepmaratonja, amely 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre Miskolc, Majális parkban. A verseny változatos távokat kínál, a maratontól a minimaratonig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára ideális kihívást. A futók a festői Bükk-hegység természeti szépségei között versenyeznek, miközben a versenyközpontban az „erdei stadionban” folyamatosan követhető a verseny alakulása. A rendezvény célja a sportbarátságok ápolása, az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a Bükk természeti értékeinek bemutatása.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
description: Az V. Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál 2026. június 6-án kerül megrendezésre a Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpontban. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a futás örömének megismertetése minden korosztály számára. A versenyen számos táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a legkisebbeknek 300 méteres tipegőtől a félmaratonig és váltóversenyekig. A futók a gyönyörű tó és a fürdő látványában gyönyörködhetnek, miközben a rekortán jellegű futópályán haladnak. A versenyhez kapcsolódó programok, díjazások és a fürdőbelépő tovább növeli az élményt.

name: Crazy5K
description: A CRAZY5K egy egyedi, 5 km-es akadályfutó verseny, amelyen 10 hatalmas, felfújható akadály várja a résztvevőket. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a szórakozásról szól, így barátokkal, családdal vagy kollégákkal együtt élvezhető egy felejthetetlen nap. Külön családi futam is elérhető, amely kifejezetten a 10 év alatti gyermekes családoknak szól, és a gyerekeknek meglepetéssel készülnek. A rendezvény helyszíne a Budaörsi Repülőtér, ahol parkolási lehetőség is biztosított. A nevezési díj tartalmaz rajtszámot, pólót, befutócsomagot, egyedi érmet, frissítést, ruhatárhasználatot és orvosi felügyeletet.

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest recurring sporting event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, certified course that delivers a memorable experience. Runners can choose from several events, including the marathon, half marathon, 10K, STEFE 5K and relay. The course is well supported, with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a great experience for all participants. The event is suitable for both active runners and families looking to enjoy exercise and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras, with a 23 km course and 1,600 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing forest singletracks, a rock city and the summit of Poludnica, with panoramic views of the Liptov region and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, and also serves as a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is among the toughest in Slovakia in its category. The 2026 event will be the final edition.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, futbalové ihrisko
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offer categories for men, women, and children across different age groups. The event also includes a two-person relay of 2 x 3 km. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who receive discounts on the entry fee.

name: Trail Run
location: Družstevná pri Hornáde, Družstevná pri Hornáde, Okružná ulica pri multifunkčnom ihrisku
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running competition featuring a natural setting and varied terrain. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with a choice of 8 km and 15 km loops, running along asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads, with elevation gain of up to 309 metres. The event also includes children’s categories with different course distances, making it suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The start and finish are located by the multifunctional sports field on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Hôrka okr. Poprad, Hôrka okr. Poprad, futbalové ihrisko Kišovce
description: Starostovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad District, at the Kišovce football pitch. The race offers a 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and the children’s categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a Good Cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a 4.4 km course. The race is open to a broad age range, from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. This community run combines sport with a good cause, and participants can compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
location: Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lúčka-nad obecným úradom
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The Run to the Summit of Minčol is a traditional running race in Lipany, offering a challenging 7,300-meter course with 649 meters of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to seniors, and also includes a competition in the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. It is organized by Tourists and Running Enthusiasts of Minčol in cooperation with the City of Lipany. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys hill running and wants to test their strength in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom (/budova obecného úradu)
description: Single-Trail Run 30 is a running race in Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, offering three distances: 25 km, 15 km, and 7 km. The race is open to men and women with no age restrictions and is organized by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Registration is available online and on site, and the event offers the chance to experience a challenging trail run in nature. The organizers provide contact information for anyone seeking further details.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea on June 6, 2026, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized personnel. Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course from ambulances and specialized personnel
additional: Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00. The race pack includes an official personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport. The entry fee is non-refundable if a participant withdraws, but the entry can be transferred until 16.05.2026. The event will take place on June 6, 2026, with participant facilities including race packs, hydration stations, and medical support.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: Race kit pickup is on Friday 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00, for BBB Ultra 60; mandatory gear checks apply, and pickup is for participants only. For the other distances, kits can be picked up on Saturday 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a single-use chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites competitors from Romania and abroad, amateurs and professionals alike, to test their limits over the Long, Middle and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a vibrant Art Nouveau city with a rich cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting, with numerous tourist attractions and modern amenities. The organizers offer attractive prizes to reward each participant’s determination and passion.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: Maraton Apuseni is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of routes for all preferences and experience levels. Participants can choose between an ultramarathon, marathon, half-marathon, cross-country race, and family race, enjoying picturesque scenery, shaded trails, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, with a friendly, festive atmosphere. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
description: Iași Sports Festival is a sporting event for everyone, from beginners to advanced competitors, held in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas. It includes a variety of events such as trail running, mountain biking, orienteering, road running, a children’s race, and a race for people with special abilities. Participants can enjoy a weekend full of activity, with challenging courses, electronic timing, and prizes in the Open categories. The festival promotes physical activity for everyone and also offers a multisport trophy to those who take part in all the events. The start and finish take place at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Maraton Apuseni is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of routes for all preferences and experience levels. Participants can choose between an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and a family race, enjoying picturesque landscapes, shaded trails, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is passionately organized by Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj. A festival atmosphere and sporting challenge come together to create a memorable experience in nature.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run is a vibrant mountain running race held in Caracal, turning the city into the capital of trail running for a day. The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about staying active. The race is both sporting and charitable in nature, promoting the values of sport and team spirit. The competition is scheduled to start at 10:00, and participants can choose between a half marathon and two cross-country races.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Serbia’s first Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes runners along the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, and aims to honor his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. Three courses are available: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more challenging Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and community.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Cup 2026 is a traditional sports, competition and recreation event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of trails, including the ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon and beginner trails, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and a chance to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide transportation to the start and extensive support throughout the event.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elite and junior riders in the men's and women's categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel amid the beautiful surroundings of Andrevlje, it lasts four days and offers an outstanding atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked trails, and a comprehensive race pack with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines a passion for sport with the natural beauty of Serbia.

name: 31. ALDI Női Futógála
description: A 31. ALDI Női Futógála egy különleges futóesemény, amely 2026. június 7-én kerül megrendezésre a budapesti Városligetben. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást, legyen az 2,5 km, 5 km vagy 10 km. A futógála célja, hogy a résztvevők kiszakadjanak a mindennapokból, élvezzék a mozgás szabadságát, és egy közösségi élmény részesei legyenek. A célban egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a futókat, hogy emlékezetessé tegye ezt a napot.

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos futóverseny, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és több távon kínál lehetőséget a részvételre, beleértve a gyerekfutamot is. A szervezők szeretettel várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a közösségi élményt.

name: PÉCS -> ORFŰ -> ABALIGET FÉLMARATON
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos félmaraton, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és családbarát programokat is kínál, például gyerekfutamot. A szervezők a helyi közösségek és az egyetem támogatásával várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a sportot.

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run is a running event in the village of Sedliska near Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses for children, juniors and adults. Runners follow a varied route through an orchard, giving the race a pleasant natural character. The children’s categories start at 10:30, while the men’s and women’s races start at 13:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska, who ensure a high-quality race experience for all age groups.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: The Charity Run in Trebišov is a traditional event that brings together running, walking, Nordic walking and cycling. This charity run offers an opportunity to discover the city of Trebišov while supporting a good cause. The event is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to spend time actively and contribute to charity.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo
description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of races organized by 3klub Šamorín, open to the general public with no age or performance limits. Runners compete in the men’s, women’s, boys’ and girls’ categories, with shorter distances for children’s races. The league runs throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run. The entry fee covers race bibs, timekeeping, refreshments and league scoring. The overall league standings are officially announced and the top runners are awarded in the final round.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská Pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on the Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers emphasize promoting sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská Pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running competition organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council, taking place on June 7, 2026. The event includes 5 km and 10 km cross-country races, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at Tinca communal stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest next to the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful scenery, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometer night race held at the Rozálka Health Complex in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Little Carpathians, illuminated by artificial lighting to create a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over, with starting corrals organized by ability. The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; pre-registration is possible until June 9, 2026.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, held over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings. Its goal is to become the largest running event in the area, attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: Maraton, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1.53 km, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a longstanding sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a variety of races for all ages and ability levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: A Brutálfutás 15.0 egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, ahol a résztvevők 2,3 vagy 7 kilométeres távokon teljesíthetnek egy katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny keverékét. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a jó hangulatról és a felejthetetlen élményekről szól, ahol a sár és a víz garantált. Egyedi befutóéremmel és sok sárral várják a futókat, akik akár jótékony futóként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény az ország több száz településéről vonzza a résztvevőket, és egy igazán szórakoztató, családias hangulatú esemény.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run
description: A Bábolna Bio Sunset Run egy hangulatos esti futóverseny, amelyet 2026. június 13-án rendeznek meg Bábolna központjában, a Strand- és Termálfürdő előtt. A verseny során a futók érintik a lovardát, valamint a híres Bábolnai Arborétumot és Állatparkot. A versenyt naplementében indítják, extra hangulatvilágítással, és a résztvevők három táv közül választhatnak, köztük félmaraton váltóban is. A versenyzők prémium rajtcsomagot kapnak, BioTechUSA frissítéssel, és minden szintidőn belül célba érkező egyedi befutóéremmel gazdagodik.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
location: Edelény, L'Huillier-Coburg kastély, Borsodi út 7, 3780 Magyarország
description: Az Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök egy hangulatos futóverseny, amely a L'Huillier-Coburg kastély környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény ideális választás azoknak, akik szeretik a kastélypark különleges atmoszféráját és az esti futás élményét. A verseny szervezői professzionális időméréssel és kényelmes regisztrációs felülettel várják a résztvevőket.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: A Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál egy hagyományos, közösségi sportesemény Kecskeméten, a Benkó domb környékén. A rendezvény célja a szabadidős mozgás és a sport népszerűsítése, amely családias hangulatban, különböző futóprogramokkal várja a résztvevőket. A fesztiválon a futás mellett jótékonysági események és közösségi programok is helyet kapnak, így a sport és a társadalmi felelősségvállalás is összekapcsolódik. A szervezők szeretettel várják a futni vágyókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a mozgás örömét és a természet közelségét.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: Az Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal futóverseny egy kihívásokkal teli, 63 km-es ultra táv, amely a Tokaj-hegyalja festői szőlőültetvényei és dombjai között vezet. A verseny három különböző távon várja a futókat, hogy kezdők és tapasztaltak egyaránt megtalálják a számukra ideális kihívást. A rendezvény nemcsak egy futóverseny, hanem egy élmény, amely Magyarország egyik legszebb borvidékének tájain zajlik. A rajtok tömegrajtos formában indulnak, és a versenyzők frissítést kapnak az útvonalon és a célban is.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: A Brutálfutás egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, amely 2,3 és 7 kilométeres távokon kínál felejthetetlen, sáros és vízes élményt. A verseny katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny keveréke, ahol a móka és a közösségi élmény áll a középpontban. Egyedi befutóéremmel és sok sárral várják a résztvevőket, akik az ország több száz településéről érkeznek. A verseny nem a komolyságról szól, hanem a szórakozásról és a kihívásról, így bárki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the first edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long, with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, and follows hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styko Memorial, honouring the renowned runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 13 June 2026 at 7:00 a.m. in Donovaly, by the Donovalský pivovar.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno, taking place on 13 June 2026. The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km course with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain and a shorter 25 km course, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park. The start and finish are at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organisers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality facilities for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross, the 5 km Small Cross, a health run, and Nordic walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, and the Big Cross consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci, with children’s categories starting at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course follows the picturesque Kysuce Valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on the cycling path for runners from 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay, and a minimarathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: The Run Through Hodkovce Park is a running event held in the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads with an asphalt surface. The event is divided into categories: an 8 km competitive run for men and women in various age groups, and non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age limit. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Online entry is available at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: The Kalvária Run is a charity race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest roads making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise and joy, while the proceeds from the run go to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality organization and support for charitable causes.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: The 2nd Summer Round of the Lemešany Running League is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a summer race.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The route crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

description: The Northern Marathon is a sporting event that brings together nature and spirit in northern Romania, offering spectacular routes for runners of all levels. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, taking place amid the impressive natural landscapes of Botoșani and its surroundings. Participants can choose from several races, including marathon, trail, and MTB, enjoying a complete experience that combines sport with tourism and local culture.
course_highlights: Spectacular routes through northern Romania
A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities
additional: Registrations validated by April 10 guarantee the official race T-shirt. After June 20, the technical T-shirt or personalized items in the race kit are not guaranteed. The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held amid the spectacular scenery of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines the demands of rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is intended for mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race brings together a passionate community and offers opportunities to socialize and push personal limits. On June 13, 2026, participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of the Retezat Mountains.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race held amid the picturesque scenery of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of Firiza Dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of the local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several events, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The routes combine sustained climbs, forest roads, and sections with spectacular views, making them suitable for mountain runners eager for adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and checkpoints along the route.

name: Maratonul Sării
description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event that combines running and mountain biking, set in the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in the Town Hall Square. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km section through the underground galleries of the Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and responsible stewardship of nature, and includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.

name: Maraton Tarcău
location: Mănăstirea Tarcău, comuna Tarcău, jud. Neamţ
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area in Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and suitable equipment, ensuring a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kit the day before the competition and must follow the official race rules. Cutoff times are clearly set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race held in the Bucegi Mountains on the Peștera–Omu Peak–Peștera route. The event takes place in the first ten days of June, when the landscape is dominated by ridges reddened by rhododendrons. The race offers runners a combination of intensity and natural beauty, and at the finish, participants are rewarded with grilled bulz and jintiță. It is an authentic mountain experience, starting from the Peștera cable car station, with a friendly, traditional atmosphere.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, which will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half-marathon and other sporting events. The route starts in Central Square and passes along the city’s main streets. The event is held under the patronage of Prince Radu, with support from several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the rules, register, and donate to support the cause.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
distance_verbose: 50 mile, 50 km, Maraton, 25 km, Semimaraton, 15 km
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Bistra Mureșului. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon with over 2,100 m of elevation gain, a half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The marathon course passes through spectacular scenery, with aid and checkpoint stations, and includes sections of forest road, unmarked trails, and scenic viewpoints. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each race. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and a campfire after the race.

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași 2026 is an untimed 5-kilometer race full of color and positive energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothes and are showered with powder at every kilometer, finishing the race in a vibrant cloud of colors. The event takes place in front of the Palace of Culture in Iași and offers a festival atmosphere with music and fun for all ages, making it perfect for a memorable day with friends and family. It is an experience accessible to everyone, including children and people with disabilities, with free registration or a full-kit option.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a trail-running event held on trails in the Bistrița area. It promotes health through exercise, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is an invitation to live fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message about direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that resonates with today’s generation.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with over 13 kilometers of groomed runs of varying difficulty, including a freeride run and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active holiday.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: A Sopron Trail 2026 terepfutóverseny Sopron-Brennbergbánya festői környezetében kerül megrendezésre 2026. június 14-én. A verseny célja a terepfutás népszerűsítése és a Soproni-hegység vadregényes részeinek bemutatása. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, köztük 5.9 km, 10.7 km és 25.9 km, melyek között az Alpokalja Terepkirály futósorozat része is megtalálható. A verseny különleges extra kihívást is kínál egy időméréses emelkedő szakaszon, ahol a legjobb férfi és női futó különdíjat kap. A versenyközpont a Brennbergbánya Kultúrházában található, ahol mosdó és zuhanyzó is rendelkezésre áll.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: A Crosskovácsi Dockyard Terepfutó verseny egy változatos távokat kínáló terepfutó esemény Nagykovácsi festői környezetében, a Teleki-Tisza-kastély környékén. A verseny négy távon zajlik: mini (3 km), rövid (7 km), középtáv (13,5 km) és hegyi félmaraton (21,7 km), mindegyik egy 1 km-es felvezető körrel indul a kastélyparkban. A pályák változatos terepen haladnak, jelentős szintemelkedéssel, és a résztvevők frissítőpontokon kaphatnak ellátást. Minden célba érkező emlékérmet kap, a verseny elektronikus időméréssel zajlik, és a szervezők kiemelt figyelmet fordítanak a versenyzők biztonságára és egészségügyi ellátására.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača (nad amfiteátrom)
description: Račiansky kros LETO is a running event in Bratislava-Rača, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gains. The main course is 16 km with 503 m of elevation gain, another course is 9.5 km with 335 m of elevation gain, and children’s races are also available. The courses run mostly through forest terrain, with some asphalt sections, and are clearly marked in three ways. The event is suitable for various age groups and offers awards to the top finishers in each category. The start is in Knižkova dolina, and the time limit for the main course is 3 hours.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, M. R. Štefánika 875
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering 10 km and 5 km courses. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal Cultural Centre. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the top three runners from Vranov are also recognized. The start and finish are at the Cultural Centre in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
location: Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Čeľovská sedmička is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race is open to various categories, including men, women, families and children, and also offers a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 is a running race organized by the Mlynčeky Municipal Office and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The race takes place at the football field in Mlynčeky and offers runners the chance to experience the atmosphere of a sporting event in beautiful surroundings. A discounted entry fee is available for early registration, and it is also possible to register on race day. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is Romania’s largest multisport event, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to 14, 2026. The festival combines sports competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, encouraging participants to run for a social cause and support the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive, welcoming setting.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and course markings will be kept to a minimum to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a backup date.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and welcoming, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. Participants receive themed superhero kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children battling this disease through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its unspoiled nature and crystal-clear water. The course winds through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky riverbanks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural beauty and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az I. Szentivánéji Futótűz egy éjszakai futófesztivál Balatonszárszón, a Tóparti parkban, amelyet Szent Iván éjszakáján rendeznek meg. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, beleértve a félmaratont, rövidebb futamokat és egy esti gyaloglást a Balaton partján. A rendezvény a nyári szezon kezdetét ünnepli, és a futók mellett családokat és közösségi sportkedvelőket is vár. A verseny az Ötpróba program része, amely pontgyűjtési lehetőséget kínál értékes jutalmakért.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A Szent László terepfutás egy hagyományos terepfutó verseny a Gerecse hegységben, Baj közelében, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny a lövész és gyalogság fegyvernem védőszentjének, Szent Lászlónak tiszteletére kerül megrendezésre, és 2010 óta rendszeresen zajlik, egyetlen alkalommal, 2013-ban az árvíz miatt maradt el. A futók változatos terepen, erdei ösvényeken és dombos vidékeken mérhetik össze erejüket. A verseny jó hangulatú, közösségi esemény, amely a természetjárás és a sport iránt érdeklődőknek egyaránt ajánlott.

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 5 km, 5 km

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: The Run Through Ludrovská Valley is a running event held in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The races offer starts for children’s categories on grass and adult categories on forest trails and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are the Municipality of Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The 2nd round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and a love of nature, and also offers a rich program of activities, including musical performances, health booths, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: The Run Through the Zalužice Fields is the second edition of a running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zalužice. This run gives participants the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplín Extreme series, which offers a range of running challenges in the region.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all proceeds from entry fees donated to fund rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without compensation, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course is mainly on asphalt and hard-packed terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organized by the Kotrmelec Sports Foundation, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football pitch. The race offers two main routes, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mainly along farm and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Racers must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, meadows and a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, a fun program of activities is planned for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children’s Race, which follows age-group routes in the historic center of the village. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in June, swapping urban asphalt for nature and offering an outdoor running experience.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
location: Sat. Breaza, Com. Lisa, Jud. Brașov
description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set in the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running and intense downhill experience. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs and the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with an elevation gain of 1,833 m, tests runners’ endurance and technique on forest roads and trails through forests and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to increase environmental education and awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition includes several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with genuine elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical assistance, and the finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, starting and finishing at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathon runners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the race offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continually improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
