name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s races, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a variety of activities for all visitors.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Competitors tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, with different participation options, including a non-competitive fitness mode and timed racing. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as keepsakes.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional running race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers various categories, including children, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the main 11,000 m race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, and the main category and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: The Moldava Cup of the Bodva is an international road race, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish on the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, which is open to the general public.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Mount Kosmaj, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great opportunity for a day out and socializing in the race village, located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages, with parental consent required for participants under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: A 32. Decathlon Futóest egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A futók negyedmaratoni, félmaratoni, páros és trió távokon mérhetik össze erejüket, miközben élvezhetik a város varázslatos éjszakai atmoszféráját. Az eseményen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és minden résztvevőt egyedi befutóérem és befutócsomag vár. A verseny 2026. június 27-én este 21:00-kor kezdődik, így a futók a város fényei között élhetik át a futás élményét.

name: SZUFLA VÉGTELEN
distance_verbose: 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
description: A 32. Decathlon Futóest egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A futók negyedmaratoni és félmaratoni távokon élvezhetik a város varázslatos hangulatát, ahol a történelem és a sport találkozik. Az eseményen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és egyedi befutóéremmel várják a résztvevőket. A verseny ideális választás mindazoknak, akik szeretnék átélni a nyári éjszakai futás élményét egy ikonikus helyszínen.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep egy barátságos, önkéntes nevezési díjas futóverseny, amely a Dióskertben kerül megrendezésre. A versenyzők a félmaraton távját négy kör teljesítésével érhetik el, de lehetőség van kevesebb kör lefutására is. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, ahol minden indulót almával, meleg teával és forralt borral várnak, valamint emlékérmet kapnak a résztvevők. Az első három helyezett férfi és női versenyző egyedi érmet is kap, az eredményhirdetés pedig 12:00-kor zajlik.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Malofatranská stovka
description: The Malofatranská Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, featuring demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
location: Domaša, Domaša, Domaša rekreačné stredisko Dobra , parkovisko pri Bogárke
description: The St. John’s Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreational resort. Runners can choose between two courses—a short 5 km course and a long 13 km course—which run mostly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. The organizers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes in kind for the winners.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: Záhorská Bystrica, Záhorská Bystrica, pri BYS3T PARK-u, na ulici Ota Holúsku - Krče
description: Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that brings together sport and support for health and the community. It will take place on 27 June 2026 at BYS3T PARK, offering a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was established in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through physical activity.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici.
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on June 27, 2026, at Urban’s Tower on Hlavná Street. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable non-cash prizes for winners in various categories. The organizers provide timing using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Chata Ride pub
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný
description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, where refreshments and additional activities for families are available. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners are required to wear their bib visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant takes part at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there is a ceremony to announce the results and award prizes to the top men and women.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, futbalový štadión
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% trail, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The start for schoolchildren is at 15:35, and for everyone else at 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family-friendly running festival offering courses for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. In addition to the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments on the course and at the finish, medical and driving services, and facilities including changing rooms and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail run in the stunning natural surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova dolina and the ridge of Spišská Magura, with the start accessed by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
location: Kubínska hoľa, Okres Dolný Kubín, Žilinský kraj
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain run in the beautiful natural surroundings of Orava, offering 24 km and 11 km courses. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and runners can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding countryside. Participants will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery that makes this event a unique experience.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodna Mountains, near Borșa, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast course with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to take part in an active weekend outdoors.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through scenic areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, giving runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a bib, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children at the starting line. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the city’s energy, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as special races for the little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic performances, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: The Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in and support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating setting.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is a 42 km marathon that requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings a special nighttime race atmosphere. There is also a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich program on the course and after the race.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the chance to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suited to all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
description: A Rácalmási Szigetfutás egy családias jellegű terepfutó verseny, amely Rácalmás festői környezetében, a természetvédelmi oltalom alatt álló Nagy-szigeten és a Duna partján zajlik. A változatos terep árnyas erdei ösvényeket, szántóföldi panorámát, folyóparti útvonalakat és aszfaltos szakaszokat kínál, minimális szintemelkedéssel. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése, minden korosztály számára elérhető sportlehetőségek biztosítása, legyen szó futásról, gyaloglásról vagy kerékpározásról. A verseny központja a történelmi Jankovich Kúria, amely ideális helyszín a rajt és cél számára, valamint a kísérő programoknak. A résztvevőket egyedi érmek és pólók várják, a rendezvény pedig barátságos, természetközeli hangulatot kínál.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Janské Lázně, nám. Svobody – kolonáda Janské Lázně
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, held in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně. The races offer several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of athletes from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until 24 May 2026, and athletes can look forward to professional organization and sponsor support.

name: Beh údolím Idy
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional race organized by the Košice-Šaca City District and the municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, while local runners can take part for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
location: Terchová okr. Žilina, Terchová okr. Žilina, Vrátna Paseky o 10,00 hod. na údolnej stanici štvorsedačky
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Festival of a Healthy Spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24
description: Az Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére egy közösségi terepfutó esemény, amely Ócsa városának nevezetességein vezet keresztül. A verseny 10,5 km-es távon zajlik, amelyet többször is meg lehet ismételni a hosszabb távokon, így 21 km és 42 km is választható. A futás egyedi chipes időméréssel történik, és a verseny célja a sport és a közösség összekapcsolása Radics József emlékének tiszteletére. A rajt és cél az Egressy Gábor Szabadidőközpont előtt van, és a pálya változatos aszfaltos és földes útvonalakat tartalmaz.

name: UTT - ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
description: A TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD egy 220 km-es terep váltóverseny, amely összeköti a történelmi Selmecbányát és Visegrádot. A verseny 18 szakaszból áll, melyek a Selmeci-hegységen és a Duna-Ipoly Nemzeti Parkon keresztül vezetnek, gazdag természeti és kulturális látnivalókkal. A futók különböző csapatméretekben és egyéni kategóriákban indulhatnak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A verseny célja a két királyi város összekapcsolása, valamint a régió természeti és történelmi értékeinek bemutatása.

name: UTT – ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will be held from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition includes four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The courses are varied and challenging, with spectacular scenery and technical climbs, offering a true test and an enjoyable experience in nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
description: A VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail egy festői futóverseny a Balaton-felvidék csodálatos tájain, Tapolca-Diszel környékén. Az útvonal 80%-ban földútból, szekérútból és ösvényből áll, változatos tereppel és páratlan panorámával várja a futókat. Öt különböző távon lehet indulni, melyek közül a 22 km-ig terjedő távok túrázva is teljesíthetők. A verseny egyedi befutóérmekkel, frissítőpontokkal és meleg étellel várja a résztvevőket, miközben a szervezők környezettudatos, zöld rendezvényt tartanak.

name: TELIHOLDFUTAM
description: A Teliholdfutam egy éjszakai futóverseny Esztergomban, amely a Várhegy, Víziváros és a dunaparti kerékpárút festői útvonalán zajlik. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 4 km, 10 km és 15 km, melyek között a 15 km-es táv a Prímás-szigetet is érinti. A futók számára kötelező a fejlámpa vagy más világító eszköz használata, mivel a pálya egyes részei kivilágítatlanok. A rendezvényt az Esztergomi Futóművek Amatőr Sportegyesület szervezi, és az esemény az Ötpróba program pontgyűjtő állomása is egyben.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
description: A IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap egy jótékonysági futóverseny Szegeden, amely éjszakai félmaraton távon várja a futókat. A rendezvény családbarát sportnapként is szolgál, ahol a résztvevők élvezhetik a közösségi sportolás örömét. A verseny helyszíne a Népkert sor, amely ideális környezetet biztosít a futáshoz és a családi programokhoz egyaránt. A rendezvény hagyományosan nagy népszerűségnek örvend, több mint 1100 résztvevővel.

name: Na hoľu
description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in Horehronie. Runners start from the square in the village of Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until July 1, 2026, with a participant limit. The entry fee includes a souvenir and refreshments.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
location: Špačince, okr. Trnava, Špačince, okr. Trnava, Základná škola s materskou školou
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in the Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the centre of the village, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in the overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organizers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, 4 to 8, and 6 runners, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good neighborly relations and promoting the region.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Carpathia Trails ~ 2027
distance_verbose: 100 km, 57 km, 50 km, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the Călimănești-Căciulata spa resort. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.

name: Siriu Open Water JOY ~ 2027
location: Barajul Siriu, Siriu, Buzău County, Romania

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legends of Nemira is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suitable for experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A HAAS Maraton Váltó egy hagyományos váltóverseny, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny a váltófutás izgalmát és a természet közelségét ötvözi, a résztvevők változatos terepen, Tata környékén mérhetik össze erejüket. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a futók mellett a szurkolók számára is élménydús programot kínál. A verseny a sportbarátok és amatőr futók számára egyaránt nyitott, és a helyi sportélet fontos eseménye.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Miles Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the 55th year in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course runs mostly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko–Fatranské Runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the chance to compete in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská Desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreational area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing they receive a race pack with a medal, food, and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour with Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, offering beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, giving you the chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours are available to all accommodation guests, with transportation to the trailhead.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
distance_verbose: 5 km, 3000 metara, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.2 km
description: The Race Around Avala is a traditional event organized by the Serbian Masters Athletics Association. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Avala and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It is an opportunity for sporting camaraderie and for promoting athletics among masters and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both challenges and enjoyment of nature.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together lovers of nature, endurance, and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All the courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races are suited to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, while the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: A VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás egy különleges élményfutás a Balatonboglári Platán strandon, ahol július 11-én a nyári Balaton-parti környezetben várják a futókat és gyaloglókat. Az új helyszín előnye a szélesebb rajt-cél folyosó, végig szilárd útburkolat és teljes közvilágítás az útvonalon. A versenyen 3,5, 7 és 10,5 kilométeres távok közül választhatnak a résztvevők, de a gyaloglás és a gyermekek 500 méteres távja is elérhető. A rendezvény minden korosztályt és futó szintet szeretettel vár, hogy együtt élhessék át az éjszakai futás varázsát.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
description: A Dráva Félmaraton egy hagyományos, Barcs és Heresznye közötti 21 kilométeres futóverseny, amelyet ötödik alkalommal rendeznek meg. A versenyen több megye futói vesznek részt, és a távot férfiak és nők külön kategóriában teljesítik. A verseny útvonala változatos, és a korábbi években rekordidők is születtek, ami a verseny komolyságát és népszerűségét mutatja. A rendezvényt a helyi Dráva Futóklub és a heresznyei önkormányzat szervezi, barátságos és versenyképes légkört biztosítva a résztvevőknek.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: A Köcsi-tó futóverseny egy hagyományos, családias hangulatú futóesemény Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred közelében, a festői szépségű Köcsi-tó környékén. A versenyen minden futni vagy gyalogolni vágyót szeretettel várnak, akik élvezhetik a természet közelségét és a közösségi sportélményt. A rendezvényt a Marathon Tömegsport és Környezetvédő Egyesület szervezi, amely elkötelezett a sport és a környezetvédelem iránt. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a 98 km main loop from Telgárt to Donovaly, crossing the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance route finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, in Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: The KL Auto Run through the Rajec Valley is a running event set in the scenic Rajec Valley, offering a combination of paved and country roads. The course runs mostly along country roads, with approximately 20% paved surface, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the best-decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with registration and the start on the square.

name: Beh zvrchovanosti Chrenovec – Brusno
location: Chrenovec-Brusno, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to showcase the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers aim to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
description: A Lázbérci Sri Chinmoy Maraton egy országos rendezésű futóverseny Magyarországon, amely Sri Chinmoy békefilozófus szellemiségében zajlik. A verseny hagyományosan a természetközeli futás élményét kínálja, és a résztvevők számára egyedülálló lehetőséget nyújt a testi-lelki harmónia megélésére. A futók változatos terepen, festői környezetben mérhetik össze erejüket és kitartásukat. A verseny családias hangulatú, és minden futóbarátot szeretettel várnak.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
location: Štrba okr. Poprad, Štrba okr. Poprad, Nám. pred Kultúrnym domom
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba in the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—which follow an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organizers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and Športový klub Štrba.

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage on this extreme terrain.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské Pancakes is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km routes for men and women with no age restrictions. The route runs mostly on asphalt, with sections across grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football field in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletracks, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and the length of the course. Three courses of varying distances and elevation gains are available, catering to runners of different levels.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Cursa Dochia, with approximately 1,500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Cursa Bate Toaca, with approximately 2,700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport without Limits Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in the town of Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a variety of events for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain trails of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running event held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on July 18, 2026. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation gains, open to adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of the mountain cultural heritage of the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: A FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban egy önköltséges, nonprofit futóverseny, amely 2026. július 19-én vasárnap 10 órakor kerül megrendezésre Dunabogdányban. A verseny két távon kínál kihívást: 6,1 km 205 méter szintkülönbséggel és 14 km 356 méter szintkülönbséggel. A futók egyedi, fém befutóérmet kapnak, és a legjobbak korosztályonként és abszolút kategóriában is díjazásban részesülnek. A verseny része az Ötpróba sorozatnak, de attól független, és a nevezés helyszíni módosítási lehetőséget is biztosít. A létszám limitált, maximum 200 fő indulhat.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza featuring 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and relay events are also available for children. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times for each distance. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Lučenec - Kalonda, hrádza na Ipli
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec–Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mostly over grass and includes a 100-metre section of disused railway track. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and youth, and also includes Nordic walking. The organizers are the town of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: A Gaja-völgy Trail egy terepfutó esemény, amelyet a Gaja-völgy Egyesület szervez második alkalommal 2026. július 25-én Fehérvárcsurgón, a Károlyi-kastély környékén. A futók és túrázók számára három különböző táv áll rendelkezésre, ahol a hangsúly nem a versenyen, hanem a mozgás örömén, a közösségi élményen és a természetközeli élményen van. A rendezvény célja a futás népszerűsítése minden szinten, kezdőktől a haladókig, egy kellemes, nyári erdei környezetben. A rajt és cél a Károlyi-kastély látogatóközpontja, a Gaja-patak csobogása és a völgy csendje pedig különleges hangulatot biztosít a résztvevőknek.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka

description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in different age groups. Registration is available online or on site until the participant limit is reached.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night race held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Runners can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided during the race, and the award ceremony takes place in the evening after the run.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
location: Košice - Furča, Košice - Furča, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Furča Košice Running Club. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the course challenges and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness areas. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval sheepfolds, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometre offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A Monorierdei Futófesztivál egy barátságos és családias futóverseny, amelyet minden évben Monorierdőn, a Makkos Parkban rendeznek meg. A versenyzők több táv közül választhatnak, és a pálya a rajt és cél helyszínén, a Makkos Parkban található. A rendezvény különlegessége az élőzenés frissítőpont, ahol a "The Little Pea" zenekar kétszer is energizálja a futókat. A verseny célja a sport és a mozgás örömének népszerűsítése, mindenkit szeretettel várnak a futótársak közé.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race taking place on 26 July 2026 in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running routes through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the start line is provided by coach. Race kits can be collected on Saturday and on Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic, energizing experience for runners of all levels.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: A Csernye Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amely 2026-ban immár hatodik alkalommal kerül megrendezésre Bakonycsernyén. A versenyzők a sportpálya melletti rajthelyről indulva választhatnak különböző távok közül, melyek változatos terepen, erdőn és dombokon vezetnek. A szervezők kiváló lebonyolítást és kellemes futóélményt ígérnek, miközben a résztvevők gyönyörködhetnek a Bakony természeti szépségeiben. A verseny családbarát, kezdők és haladók számára egyaránt ajánlott.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
description: Az Orfűi Tó-Show Futás a Melitta Szabadidő Sportegyesület hagyományos futóversenye, amely az Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny során a Pécsi tavat egyszer vagy kétszer kell megkerülni közúton, az óra járásával megegyező irányban, nem a sétányon. A futóverseny családbarát esemény, ahol a részvétel mindenki saját felelősségére történik, és a versenyzők között nem csak profik, hanem amatőrök is egyaránt indulhatnak. A rendezvény a Barta Textilház támogatásával valósul meg, és a futók számára értékes jutalmakat biztosít, nem csak az időeredmények alapján.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail-running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for exercising in nature.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara on August 1, 2026, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and supports the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor race in an urban natural setting, suitable for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation to encourage people to take up running and get involved in the community.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to Everest. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until places are filled.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three courses of varying lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 21:00 by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the course, allowing even the slowest participants to finish successfully. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature of Fruška Gora at night.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriški venac, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Monument to Freedom, Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which wind through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake. The race combines adrenaline-pumping obstacles with beautiful scenery and concludes in a spirit of camaraderie and celebration at the end of the season. The event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: A Keresztúri Öntúlszárnyalás Futófesztivál egy családias hangulatú futóverseny, amely a természet közelségét és az öntúlszárnyalás szellemét ötvözi. A verseny a Keresztúri erdőben, Budapest közelében zajlik, és több távon kínál kihívást, beleértve az 5,2 km, 10,5 km, félmaraton, 31,6 km és maraton távokat, valamint a különleges Yes, I can! versenyszámot. Ez az esemény a Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team szervezésében valósul meg, amely 1977 óta támogatja a futás szerelmeseit. A verseny célja, hogy minden résztvevő megtapasztalhassa a sportbarátságot és az önmagukon való túllépés örömét.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km races as well as children’s runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: A Jazzfőváros-futás Kecskeméten, a Benkó Zoltán Szabadidőközpontban kerül megrendezésre, és a jazzfesztivál sportos kiegészítőjeként kínál futási élményt. A rendezvény hagyományosan a futás örömét és a közösségi élményt helyezi előtérbe, nyitott minden korosztály és futótípus számára. A verseny nemcsak sportesemény, hanem a helyi közösség összefogását is erősíti, miközben a résztvevők gyönyörű környezetben, jó levegőn mozoghatnak. A szervezők a jótékonyságot is fontosnak tartják, így a futás egyben támogatási lehetőség is.

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
