name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The routes cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of the Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term plan for continuity.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting, and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event features marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an outdoor experience on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the welcoming community atmosphere. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.

name: 44. Kanjiža Running & Swimming Festival
distance_verbose: 13 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metara, 2.6 km, 1.4 km, 0.9 km, 0.57 km, 0.2 km

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A SZUFLA Futófesztivál egy hagyományos, közösségi futóesemény, amelyet a Szigethalmi Ultrafutók Lelkes Alakulata rendez meg minden év augusztus második hétvégéjén. A 2026-os jubileumi, 20. futófesztivál a Tököli parkerdőben kerül megrendezésre, változatos távokkal, amelyek között ultramaraton, váltó, félmaraton, rövidebb futások és túrázás is szerepel. A verseny családias hangulatú, és a futók mellett a gyerekeket is számos program várja. A rendezvény célja a sport népszerűsítése és a helyi közösség támogatása, különös tekintettel a fogyatékkal élők segítésére.

name: RossbRUNn Trail
location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
distance_verbose: 56 km, Maraton, 28 km, 14 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Motorest Javorina Lenartov
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course winds through beautiful countryside and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and scenic views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail-running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing together passionate runners in a remarkable natural setting. The routes are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.

name: Ultra Race Romania
description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route through the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary scenery and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event focuses on the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianskonovovesský Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov District and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football field in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere and well-organized event. The course is suitable for runners of various levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners looking to enjoy a sporting event in a beautiful setting.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: The Relay Run from the Tatras to the Danube is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is mostly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of total ascent and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 legs of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each member runs three legs. The race is a test of team spirit and endurance in Slovakia’s beautiful surroundings.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A Sárkányfutás egy izgalmas futóverseny, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny terepfutás jellegű, változatos és kihívásokkal teli útvonalon zajlik, amely a természet közelségét és a sport élményét ötvözi. A rendezvény barátságos hangulatú, minden korosztály számára nyitott, és a futók közösségi élményét is erősíti. A verseny helyszíne Súr, Magyarország, és a szervezők nagy hangsúlyt fektetnek a gördülékeny lebonyolításra és a résztvevők elégedettségére.

name: Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of varying levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: The Count Július Andrássy Route Run takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers several categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 and older children up to 13. The organizer, Ing. Michal Majcher, ensures a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially prepared trails, surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running together as a community.

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is Romania’s most beautiful night cross-country race, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked routes after dark. Races are available for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children over distances of 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age groups from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.

name: KESZTHELYI KILOMÉTEREK
description: A Keszthelyi Kilométerek egy hagyományos futóverseny a Balaton partján, amely 2026. augusztus 22-23-án kerül megrendezésre a Festetics-kastély hátsó parkjában. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, 3 km-től egészen a félmaratonig, egyéniben és váltóban is. Emellett gyermek futamok is várják a legkisebbeket, korcsoportonként különböző távokon. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a Balaton-parti környezet különleges élményt nyújt a futóknak.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance walk starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing a region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is certified by ITRA, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organized by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides a warm welcome and high-quality organization.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km hobby race for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course runs along paved roads, meadows, and forest and field paths, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie
description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race taking place on 22 August 2026 in the village of Čachtice. The course is mostly on asphalt, running through the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The route is gently rolling, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is on the grounds of the Čachtice Elementary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, areál Ščava
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charity race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, in the Stará Ľubovňa district. The event has a voluntary entry fee and supports aid and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.

name: Lukačovská 5
location: Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held on the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event offers a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race begins at 11:00.

name: Harhovská desiatka
location: Spišský Hrhov, Spišský Hrhov, pred Obecným úradom
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Rimavské Brezovo, Rimavské Brezovo, Športové ihrisko
description: The Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District. Its route runs along asphalt, field, and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including participants aged 15 and under and those over 15. The organizers offer two entry categories, with a large or small package, making it possible to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings near the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels.

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, surrounded by beautiful scenery, unspoiled forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances: a long 20 km run with 718 m of elevation gain, the intermediate 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, or a short 5 km course. The event also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the top runners can win valuable prizes.

name: 2X2 Race
location: Lacul Bâlea, Transfăgărășan, Sibiu County, Romania
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m elevation gain) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m elevation gain), are also highly technical and intense, and intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates Romania’s nature and unique heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1,292 m, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište. The race features three different courses that are technically demanding and physically challenging, intended for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified according to ISF, ITRA and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers different age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to each age group, with 400 m and 200 m circuits. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetups with athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs across mown grass, paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the nature of the Tatras. The organizer, OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ensures the event runs smoothly.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run repeated 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-focused experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: A MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run egy egyedülálló esti és éjszakai futóverseny Szombathely főterén, amely gyermekeknek és amatőr futóknak egyaránt kínál lehetőséget a részvételre. A verseny különleges hangulatát a naplemente és a város központjának atmoszférája adja, így egy kellemes és motiváló futóélményt nyújt. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden korosztály számára elérhetővé tegye a futást, miközben közösségi élményt is biztosít.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
description: A Budai Night Trail egy izgalmas terepfutó verseny, amely a Budai-hegység festői erdei ösvényein zajlik éjszaka. A résztvevők fejlámpával a fejükön futnak, így különleges élményben lehet részük a sötétben, változatos terepviszonyok között. A verseny két távon, 13,5 km és 17,3 km hosszban kínál kihívást, jelentős szintemelkedéssel. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a rajt Telkin, a Sportcsarnoknál van.

name: SUHANJ!6
description: A SUHANJ! 6 egy jótékonysági futóverseny, amely a fogyatékossággal élőket támogatja, és a SUHANJ! Alapítvány nonprofit munkáját segíti. A verseny a Margitszigeti Atlétikai Centrumban zajlik, ahol a résztvevők 6 óra alatt a lehető legtöbb kört futják egy 3,5 km-es, sík, akadálymentes körpályán. A verseny éjszaka, éjfélkor kezdődik, és garantált a napfelkelte látványa. Egyéni és csapat kategóriákban is lehet nevezni, a csapatok 2-10 fősek lehetnek, és korlátlan váltás engedélyezett. Emellett éjfélkor rajtol az Éj Félmaraton, amely a SUHANJ! 6 pályáján zajlik, létszámlimitje 200 fő.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep egy barátságos, körözős futóverseny, amely Törökbálint Dióskertjében kerül megrendezésre. A versenyzők a félmaratoni távot négy körben teljesítik, de lehetőség van kevesebb kör lefutására is. A nevezési díj önkéntes, körönként 500 Ft, amely a verseny költségeit támogatja. Minden indulót alma, meleg tea és forralt bor vár, valamint emlékérem, az első három férfi és női helyezett pedig egyedi érmet kap. Az eredményhirdetés 12:00-kor zajlik.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular trails in the heart of nature, at the meeting point of Retezat and Domogled–Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, around the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the area's tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.

name: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică
location: Putna-Vrancea Natural Park, Vrancea County, Romania

name: Iskra Avala Night Trail
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on 29 August 2026 on Mount Avala. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the special atmosphere of a nighttime adventure, with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top men and women in both distances.

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci combining running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program running throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and the sporting challenges.

name: NYAKVÁGÓ MARATON
distance_verbose: Maraton, 22.5 km, 14 km, 7.3 km, 3000 meter, 0.4 km
description: A Nyakvágó Maraton egy kemény terepfutó verseny Kiskunságban, Ballószög közelében, amely a maraton távját kínálja, de nehezebb körülmények között. A verseny változatos távokat kínál, beleértve a 14 km, 22,5 km és 42 km futást, valamint terepkerékpár versenyt. A pálya természetközeli, mezőgazdasági földutakon halad, és 4-5 kilométerenként frissítőpontok várják a résztvevőket. A rendezvény célja a sportos életmód népszerűsítése és a helyi közösség összefogása. A versenyzőknek kötelező a természet védelme és a szabályok betartása, a terepkerékpárosoknak bukósisak viselése kötelező.

name: UFO ÓCSA FUTÁS
description: Az UFÓ Ócsa Futás egy népszerű városi futóverseny, amely Ócsa városában, az Egressy Gábor Szabadidőközpont környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, köztük 10,5 km-es és 21 km-es futamokat, amelyek a város nevezetességein vezetnek keresztül. A verseny egyedi chipes időméréssel zajlik, és a helyezéseket a bruttó idő alapján rangsorolják. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, korhatár megkötésekkel, és korlátozott indulói létszámmal várja a futókat.

name: Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Runners can expect courses along gravel and hiking trails, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organized by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: The Run beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses are on asphalt and dirt roads, while the children’s categories cover distances from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main category starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on the day.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic experience in nature for runners of all levels. The race features two main events: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both take place on varied, unpaved routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with support from Păulești City Hall, and promotes respect for the wilderness and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting wildlife rehabilitation in Romania.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing the connections between participants and their shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.

name: Avala noćna trail 2026
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race taking place on August 29, 2026, on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 8:30 p.m. and offers a unique night-time experience on Mount Avala, with a race village providing entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is mandatory. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top men and women in both distances.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: Az EMU 6 Napos Verseny, más néven a GOMU 6 Napos Világbajnokság, a világ egyik legrangosabb többnapos ultramaraton eseménye, amely Balatonfüreden kerül megrendezésre. A verseny során a résztvevők hat napon keresztül futnak, megmérettetve állóképességüket és kitartásukat. A verseny hagyományosan a többnapos ultrafutás csúcspontja, ahol világrekordok is születtek. A versenyzők egyedülálló kihívás előtt állnak, amely a fizikai és mentális erőnlétet egyaránt próbára teszi.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the Multifunctional Building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories begin at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, which welcome runners of all ages and abilities. The race is ideal for anyone looking to run in beautiful surroundings, with the finish at Plaveč Castle.

name: Șopa Forest Race ~ 2027
location: Șopa Forest, Șelimbăr, Sibiu County, Romania

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
description: A Sümeg Trail futóverseny Sümeg városának kiemelt sporteseménye, amely már ötödik éve vonzza a futás szerelmeseit. A verseny négyféle távon kínál kihívást, melyeket a résztvevők a város különleges és szép környezetében teljesíthetnek. A rendezvényhez számos sportprogram és egészségügyi szűrőprogram is kapcsolódik, így a futás mellett jógaórák, meditáció és egyéb mozgásformák is várják az érdeklődőket. A Sümeg Trail egy lendületes, közösségi esemény, amely a sport és az egészséges életmód népszerűsítését szolgálja.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
