price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok is a challenging mountain race in the stunning surroundings of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities across a variety of surfaces and terrain. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 a.m. from Srdiečko and finishing at Chopok, at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level. There are two main routes: SkyMarathon Chopok, 43 km long with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter Sky Race Jasná Trail, 21 km long with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay teams can also take part in the longer race. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour time limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners can make use of six aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, headlamp, mobile phone with an active SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest and sufficient fluids. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories will receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events held in Prešov throughout 2026. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and make exercise enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of Prešov Running Team can run for free.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: The 6-Hour Run Under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers the chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings below the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská Twelve is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Participants can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural center.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach is a traditional mountain uphill race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The programme also includes children’s races, and runners can purchase an entry with original Horský kros Gerlach socks.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry is a running event held in the picturesque setting of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a start for children at 14:00 and for adults at 16:00, with the course running on natural surfaces along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák, in cooperation with the Žiť Tatry civic association, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, while children’s races are held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary donations in place of an entry fee, and refreshments. Volunteers support runners throughout the day, and times are recorded by timekeepers, followed by the announcement of the winners and the presentation of prizes.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Jud. Alba
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The courses are varied, with significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, welcoming both experienced runners and those looking to make the transition to ultramarathons. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.

name: StruguRUN
description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each following spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on-site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: The Dukla Run for Peace is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The route runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historical treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.

name: CIUCAȘ X3 Scriem povestea. Împreună clădim tradiție.
organizer: Clubul de Turism și Alpinism Ciucaș Ploiești
description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A range of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a history spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied routes in a friendly atmosphere with professional organization.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championships in Râșnov bring together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course combined with Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and scenic terrain.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: A XI. Moonlight Run egy hangulatos futóverseny Szob városában, amely 2026. szeptember 12-én kerül megrendezésre. A verseny résztvevői időmérést, rajtszámot és egyedi befutóérmet kapnak. A pályán és a célban frissítés biztosított, a célban pedig hagyományos zsíroskenyér hagymával várja a futókat. A rendezvény orvosi felügyelet mellett zajlik, és a szervezők a részvétel élményét helyezik előtérbe.

name: ATOMFUTÁS
description: Az ATOMfutás egy népszerű futóverseny Paks városában, amely 2026. szeptember 12-én kerül megrendezésre az ASE sportcsarnok környékén. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény hagyományosan jelentős early bird kedvezményekkel várja a nevezőket, és családias, barátságos hangulatban zajlik. A verseny célja a sport és a közösség erősítése, miközben a résztvevők élvezhetik a változatos pályákat és a paksi környezet szépségeit.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
description: A MOONLIGHT RUN egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Szob városában, amely 2026. szeptember 12-én kerül megrendezésre. A verseny rajtja és célja a Szent László templomnál található, és a résztvevők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak. A rendezvény során frissítés és orvosi felügyelet biztosított, a célban pedig hagyományos zsíroskenyér hagymával várja a futókat. A verseny szervezője a Proathlon Bt., a helyi önkormányzatok támogatásával.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: A 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton egy hagyományos futóverseny, amely Edelény környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny változatos távokon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a résztvevők számára professzionális időmérést biztosítanak RFID chipes rendszerrel. A versenyzők élvezhetik a Bódva-völgy természeti szépségeit és a változatos terepet.

name: BRUTÁLATOM
description: A BrutálATOM egy kihívásokkal teli futóverseny, amelyet az Atomerőmű Sportegyesület rendez Paks városában, az ASE sportcsarnok közelében. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, köztük gyerekeknek és felnőtteknek, különböző nehézségi szinteken. A rendezvény hagyományosan szeptember közepén kerül megrendezésre, és a résztvevők számára egyedülálló élményt nyújt a helyszín és a szervezés révén. A verseny fővédnöke dr. Kovács Antal olimpiai bajnok, ami tovább emeli a verseny presztízsét.

name: SZŐLŐSKÖR
distance_verbose: 50 km, 36 km, 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: The Night Run Through Lučenec is a night race along the illuminated streets of Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place near the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Participants can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children of various age groups, held in Lučenec near the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is open to boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men by age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women, and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on 12 September 2026. Runners will enjoy routes passing by Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances to compete in—11 km and 22 km—and the course also features a Conti Speed Section, where a valuable prize is up for grabs.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and leisure event set in the beautiful surroundings of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unique run combines nature with quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding countryside and the chance to relax at the resort after the race. Marina Liptov is an ideal destination for athletes and families looking for an outdoor experience.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany, in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sports outdoors. It is organised by the Garden of Movement, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The 5 km course offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere surrounded by nature. Registration is available online at a discounted price and on site for a higher fee. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and performance levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The race is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.

name: Woodrocks Trail Run
description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three storybook courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an exhilarating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 metres of elevation gain over rugged terrain and scenic ridgelines. The event celebrates the joy of running in nature and supports environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Nature Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining scenic landscapes with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, while the organizers promote an active community committed to supporting sport and the environment.

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, eco-friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half marathon, an 8 km race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Fortress, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: The Bukovac Marathon – Long Course is a challenging mountain race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The course is 47.8 km long, with 1,350 metres of ascent and 1,350 metres of descent. It is well maintained and marked with red-and-white hiking blazes, and passes significant sites including the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgeteg, Krušedol and Velika Remeta monasteries, as well as Branko’s Grave and monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the natural surroundings and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.

name: Kis-Balaton RUN 2026
description: A Kis-Balaton Kör Futóverseny egy országos meghirdetésű, egyre népszerűbb futóverseny Zalakaroson, amelyet a Zalakarosi Futrinkák szerveznek. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, köztük egy 35 km-es egyéni és váltó futamot, félmaratont, valamint gyermek- és családi futóversenyeket. A rendezvény hagyományosan szeptemberben kerül megrendezésre, és a Karos Korzó ad otthont a rajtnak és a célnak. A verseny pohármentes, így a résztvevőknek saját frissítő eszközöket kell hozniuk. A futóverseny családias hangulatú, és értékes nyereményekkel, befutóérmekkel várja a résztvevőket.

name: Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie District, offering courses for various age groups and ability levels. The races cover 2.5 km and 5 km, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting day in the pleasant surroundings of the village.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: The Run Around Spiš Castle is a traditional running race in Spišské Podhradie, featuring a mix of asphalt and compacted dirt roads with grassy sections. The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The event is organized by the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. Registration is available online or on site, and residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race held in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, with clear participation requirements, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race bib throughout the race. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated start and finish area. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque scenery of Râșnov.
course_highlights: Route through the center of Râșnov
Unique medieval atmosphere
Timing and first-aid facilities provided
additional: Participants must bring an identity document when collecting their race kit. They must present a medical certificate or accept responsibility for their physical fitness. The race bib must be worn on the front of the shirt throughout the race, from start to finish. Participants must present identification and a medical certificate, and wear their race bib visibly. Registration is online, with on-site registration also possible while places remain.

name: Rombat Trail Run
description: Rombat Trail Run is a mountain running race that invites over 600 nature lovers to take part in the spectacular natural landscape of the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests. The event offers an authentic trail-running experience, combining athletic challenge with the beauty of the surrounding environment. Organized by Runners Club, this competition is for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and test their limits in a friendly, professional setting.

name: Zăvoi Trail Comana
description: Zăvoi Trail Comana is a sporting event for trail running and mountain biking enthusiasts, held in the heart of Comana Natural Park, a protected area with impressive biodiversity. The event takes place on September 12–13, 2026, and is organized by the Plogging for Romania Association, which promotes sport and environmental protection through plogging activities. The routes offer an authentic nature-exploration experience, combining athletic challenge with awareness of the importance of protecting the local ecosystem. Participants can choose between mountain bike and trail running races, each featuring spectacular and accessible routes.

name: Baia Mare Half Marathon
organizer: Maramureș Runners, Rotary Club Baia Mare
description: The Baia Mare Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from across the country to celebrate movement, community, and an active lifestyle. The main race is the 21 km half marathon, held on an urban course consisting of 6 loops of 3.5 km each, for participants over the age of 15. The event also includes relay races, a 7 km cross-country race, a 3 km fun run, children’s races, and a special AutiSmile race dedicated to people with autism. The organizers emphasize health, community, and environmental protection, planting trees for every kilometer run.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Malý Pieninský Marathon – Bohuš Ježík Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor, offering an 18 km course with 163 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the Dunajec River Gorge, with half the surface paved and half forest trail. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The entry fee includes a medal, a gift, a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, a non-competitive 9+9 km relay is also available.

name: dm Balaton Run 5 / 10 / 21
description: A dm Balaton RUN 2026. szeptember 19-én Zamárdiban kerül megrendezésre, és a Balaton egyik legszebb partszakaszán kínál futási lehetőséget. A verseny családbarát, kezdőknek és haladóknak egyaránt ajánlott, több távon: 2,3 km, 5,25 km, 10,5 km, félmaraton, valamint félmaraton váltó. A rajtcsomag prémium Mizuno pólót tartalmaz, a célban egyedi tervezésű befutóérem vár, és környezetbarát, pohármentes frissítést biztosítanak. A futóútvonal nagyrészt a vízparton halad, így a résztvevők élvezhetik a Balaton hangulatát és a kora őszi napsugarakat.

name: Túrkevei Bagolyfutam
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.75 km, 0.4 km

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
description: A Bakonyalja Futás egy hagyományos terepfutó verseny, amely Tárkány és Ászár környékén kerül megrendezésre. A versenyt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi, amely több szakosztállyal támogatja a futó- és tájfutó sportokat. A futók változatos terepen, természetközeli környezetben mérhetik össze erejüket, élvezve a Bakonyalja festői tájait. A rendezvény barátságos hangulatú, minden korosztály számára nyitott.

name: DOMB42X (2.)
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
description: A DOMB42X egy különleges futóverseny Kecskemét legmagasabb pontján, a Benkó-Dombon, ahol a résztvevők többször is fel- és lefutnak a közel 50 méter magas dombra. A pálya egy kör hossza 1,0047 km, amelyet a távnak megfelelően 3-tól 42-szer kell teljesíteni, így a verseny félmaratontól ultramaratonig terjed. A verseny különlegessége a jelentős szintemelkedés, amely a maratoni távon több mint 2000 méter. A rendezvény családbarát, a kísérők számára ingyenes a belépés, és a szabadidőparkban számos program és sportolási lehetőség várja őket.

name: Runway Run 2026
location: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport, Budapest, Hungary

name: Big Bear's Ultra
description: Big Bear's Ultra is a challenging ultra-trail race around the city of Žilina, offering a unique running experience in nature with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The race takes place near the Považské Museum and Budatín Castle and features various distances that test runners’ endurance and determination. The course runs through hills and mountain areas with significant elevation gain, making the event a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers emphasize an eco-friendly approach and participant safety.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: The Half Marathon is a certified half marathon with World Athletics international status, held in Nitra’s historic centre at Svätopluk Square. The event brings together sport, community and charity, offering runners a unique experience in an Oktoberfest atmosphere. Alongside the half marathon, the festival also features relays, family and senior runs, charity runs and children’s races. The organisers emphasise a healthy lifestyle, inclusion and community cooperation in the region.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Myjava, Myjava, pred MsÚ v Myjave
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava
description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka is a running race in Myjava offering a 10 km course for men and women, with shorter options for women and the Buď - fit category. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Myjava and is organized by TJ Spartak Myjava Athletics Club and the town of Myjava. The main race starts at 13:00, while primary school boys and girls start at 10:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, including age-based categories and special categories for Buď fit and children.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
location: Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná, Lanyiho Huta
description: Dobšinská desiatka is a traditional running race organized by the ŠK Dobšiná civic association. It takes place in the picturesque setting of Lányiho Huta in Dobšiná. The race features a varied course combining forest roads and asphalt, suitable for runners in different categories, including Nordic walking. The event also includes activities such as an autograph session with Slovak Olympians and family activities, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
description: Kapušianska 5-ka is a running race held in Kapušany Park in the village of Kapušany. The race is open to various age groups, including juniors, adults, and veterans. It is an enjoyable sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and community sports. The event is organized by the municipality of Kapušany, which also provides support and contact information for participants.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Košice, Košice, vstupný areál USS Košice Šaca
description: The U. S. Steel Košice Summer Sports Games are a traditional event that has been held for 34 years, giving employees the opportunity to compete in a variety of sports. The games include athletics, badminton, bowling, tennis, football, table tennis, beach volleyball, cycling, chess and darts. The event is for U. S. Steel Košice employees and promotes sportsmanship and team spirit in the pleasant surroundings of the USS Košice Šaca complex. Golf tournaments and other sporting activities are also organized alongside the competitions.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
description: Generali Trail Hubkovou is a running race in Humenné organized by Bežecký klub Humenné with support from the city and local sponsors. The race takes place in the square by the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers categories for men, women, juniors, and children. The main race starts at 13:00, and the children’s categories begin at 11:00. Participants can choose from several entry packages, which include a medal, a promotional pack, a raffle, refreshments, and a technical T-shirt. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with refreshments along the course.

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateurs and professionals, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical-race course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop. The race lasts 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt trails and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.

name: Mogoșa Race
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from 4 km for all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km route, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The race promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area in a vibrant, community atmosphere. It is organized by the Baia Mare în Mișcare Association, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

name: OMU MARATHON by Transilvania 100
description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

name: Radmilovac Trail
description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green natural oasis of Radmilovac, not far from Belgrade. The race takes runners through orchards, vineyards, and fishponds, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category for PhDs and doctoral candidates, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle. The event is organized by the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun and AGRIF runners, and is known for its generous race pack and prizes for the top competitors.

name: Soko Čovka trail
description: Soko Čovka Trail is a mountain race held in Lazarevac, Županjac. It is organized by the VIS Mountaineering Club and gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of central Serbia on challenging trails. The race brings together nature and sports enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Lazarevac and Županjac
Mountain terrain with challenging climbs and descents
Views of central Serbia and the surrounding landscapes

name: 6. Liget élményfutás 7 / 3.5
description: A 6. Liget Élményfutás egy különleges futóesemény Budapest Városligetében, ahol a 3,5 és 7 kilométeres távokon családok és barátok együtt élvezhetik a sport örömeit és a több mint 20 akadály izgalmát. A futás nem a versenyről, hanem az élményről szól, ahol a mosoly és a közös kaland a legfontosabb. A résztvevőket egyedi befutóérem és befutócsomag várja, így garantált a felejthetetlen nap. A rendezvény ideális mind kezdőknek, mind tapasztalt futóknak, akik szeretnének egy vidám, közösségi élményben részt venni a Városliget varázslatos környezetében.

name: FESTÉK BÁZIS JÁNOSHÁZAI FÉLMARATON
description: A FESTÉK BÁZIS Jánosházai Félmaraton egy jó hangulatú, jól szervezett futóverseny, amelyet amatőrök és profik egyaránt élvezhetnek. A verseny biztonságos, forgalomtól elzárt útvonalakon zajlik, és minden célba érő résztvevő befutó érmet kap, valamint meglepetés befutó csomagot. A rendezvényen pontos időmérés, frissítés 5 km-enként, valamint online képgaléria is rendelkezésre áll. A verseny végén a szervezők helyben készített marhapörkölttel kedveskednek a nevezőknek, így a futás után a közösségi élmény is garantált.

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the MAPENZI by Generation of Love civic association and the municipality of Bešeňov. The races take place at the football field in Bešeňov and include 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a recreational 2 km run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable in nature and suitable for the general public, including people of various age groups.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
location: Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov
description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses of 16.8 km and 9.7 km, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The event is organized by the municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with neighboring municipalities. The race is suitable for the general public, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.

name: Oradea City Running Day
description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event held in Oradea, offering running races for all ages and fitness levels. The courses include a half marathon, a corporate relay, a 10.5 km race, and a popular 5 km run, all held on an urban route marked with blue arrows that passes through notable areas of the city. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, especially through the relay race dedicated to company employees. Participants receive race kits with an electronic chip and have access to refreshment points along the route.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: The Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest team-building event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. The organizers, Runners Club, provide a friendly and professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking, and a 3 x 7 km relay, welcoming runners of different abilities and ages. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a city known for its big heart and generous hosts.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: CURSA IMPOSIBILĂ
description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event in which participants reach the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge held throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with a range of distances, some even thousands of kilometers long. The event emphasizes community spirit and supporting causes, and awards a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.

name: Masterprint Tihany Cross Terepfutás és Nordic Walking 5 / 10 / 20 / 30
description: A Masterprint Tihany Cross terepfutó és freestyle nordic walking verseny a festői Tihanyi-félszigeten kerül megrendezésre, változatos távokkal 5, 10, 20 és 30 km-en. A verseny útvonala gyönyörű őszi levendulamezőkön és dombos, erdei ösvényeken halad, amelyeket piros jelölőszalagok jelölnek. A rendezvény családbarát, gyermekfutamokkal és váltóversennyel is várja a résztvevőket. A versenyközpont a Belső-tó partján található, ahol a frissítőpontok és a célterület is jól felszerelt. A versenyzők számára professzionális technikai futópóló is rendelhető.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep egy barátságos, körözős futóverseny, amely a Dióskertben kerül megrendezésre. A versenyzők a félmaraton távját négy kör teljesítésével érhetik el, de lehetőség van kevesebb kör lefutására is. A nevezési díj önkéntes, körönként 500 Ft, amely a verseny költségeit támogatja. Minden indulót alma, meleg tea és forralt bor vár, valamint emlékérem, az első három férfi és női helyezett pedig egyedi érmet kap. Az eredményhirdetés 12:00-kor zajlik.

name: BUCI FUTÁS
location: Soroksár Sportcsarnok, Sportcsarnok utca 2, Soroksár, Budapest, Hungary

name: BÜK–CSEPREG FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 7 km, 1.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km

name: ULTRA MÁRTÉLY
location: Bodnár Bertalan Természet- és Környezetvédelmi Oktatóközpont, Mártély, Hungary

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.3 km hobby run with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and marking. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive discounted entry fees. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The trails follow the historic Amber Road and pass through blooming wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is listed as a UTMB Index Race, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon. Both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section, with a valuable prize up for grabs.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run with Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice near St. Elisabeth Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from entry fees go to the Oáza - Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine a sporting challenge with supporting a good cause.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and music. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, in the area around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Fortifications Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.

name: ASCOTID Trail Race
organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)
description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual off-road running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a focus on social and health goals.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charity sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, near Sucevița. The event supports palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately difficult races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The courses offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a community of runners. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. The organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, catering to both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race-kit pickup available in the days leading up to the event and on race day.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, set amid the scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, with courses that combine physical challenge, storybook scenery, and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and aid stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.

name: RUN FOR LIFE
location: Dumbrava Vlăsiei, Snagov, Ilfov County, Romania

name: Župska vinska trka 2026
description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sporting and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the region’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packs can be collected until 11:00.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
description: Az Esztergom Félmaraton egy változatos távú futóverseny, amely Esztergom történelmi városrészein, a Várhegyen, a Vízivároson és a dunaparti kerékpárúton zajlik. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak az egyéni és váltó futók, a gyerekeknek pedig külön rövidebb futamokat szerveznek. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és az Ötpróba program pontgyűjtő állomásaként is szolgál, így a résztvevők pontokat gyűjthetnek és jutalmakat szerezhetnek. A verseny fővédnökei között Esztergom város polgármestere és ismert sportolók is szerepelnek, ami a verseny rangját emeli.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
description: A Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 futóversenyt ötödik alkalommal rendezik meg Kapuváron, az Eszterházi parkban. A verseny teljesen sík, városi utcákon zajlik, és évről évre egyre több hazai és külföldi futót vonz. A rendezvény célja a közösségi élmény és a mozgás örömének megosztása, ahol a jó hangulat és az összetartozás áll a középpontban. A befutó után is folytatódik az élmény, díjazásokkal és egy nagy rendezvénysátorral, ahol a szurkolók kényelmesen biztathatják a futókat.

name: BERLIN MARATON
description: A BMW BERLIN-MARATHON a világ egyik legnagyobb és legnépszerűbb maratonversenye, amely 2026. szeptember 27-én kerül megrendezésre Berlinben. A verseny híres a rekorddöntő, rendkívül sík pályájáról, amely a város legszebb nevezetességein vezet keresztül. A rendezvény nemcsak a profi futók, hanem a futás szerelmesei számára is különleges élményt nyújt, köszönhetően a sokszínűségnek és a város egyedülálló energiájának. A verseny része az Abbott World Marathon Majors sorozatnak, és a résztvevők számos lehetőség közül választhatnak, beleértve a jótékonysági futást, inline görkorcsolyázást és a Generali 5K futamot is.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of events for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka, with a family-friendly atmosphere, and culminates in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km, and 15 km categories, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that combines history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three race distances: a 4.3 km hobby run for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and an 850 m children’s race for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable awards. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal that is part of the Marathon Tour.

description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the scenic surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering routes of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. The organizer, the Liptov Olympic Club, provides high-quality technical and medical services.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo
description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and are open to various age groups, from preschool children to adults. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers participants the opportunity to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.

name: Crosul Arenelor
description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: the Arcul de Triumf National Stadium and the National Arena. The race runs in one direction, with no turnarounds, along the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheer points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation and taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition—it is a call to action for movement and community involvement.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba on Rajac is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant costumes, who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural and artistic activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk traditions.

A negyedmaratoni távon chipes időmérés, frissítőpontok és érmek várják a résztvevőket, a verseny ingyenes minden távon. A rendezvény célja a közösségi sportolás és a futás népszerűsítése, emléket állítva Maróti Istvánnak.

description: A MAPEI Tihanyi Félmaraton egy hagyományos, 11. alkalommal megrendezett futóverseny Tihanyban, amely változatos távokat kínál a kezdőktől a haladókig. A verseny különlegessége a Balaton-felvidék gyönyörű panorámája és a kihívást jelentő, változatos terep, amely a félsziget legszebb részeit érinti. A félmaraton távját sokan választják első félmaratonjuknak, hiszen a pálya összetétele és a látványos szakaszok felejthetetlen élményt nyújtanak. A rendezvény családbarát, a legkisebbeknek babyrun is van, és minden távon befutóéremmel, frissítéssel, valamint futópólóval várják a résztvevőket.

The race is designed for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running get-together: “Go as you can around Jarabá.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.

location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in pleasant natural surroundings, with an emphasis on nature conservation and a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which promotes sport and ecological values.
course_highlights: The routes run 65% along forest roads and 33–35% on forest trails
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the race distance
Aid stations are available at several points along the course, depending on the race distance
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarpatské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have limits of 5 or 7 hours. Aid stations are available along the course depending on the race distance. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž. The race takes place on 3 October 2026. Registration is available through the official website. Race categories include various age groups. Most distances have no time limit.

description: Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race in which each 6.7 km lap must be completed within one hour. Participants start every hour on the hour, and anyone who fails to finish in time or drops out is eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing the physical and mental limits of the competitors. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that brings together sport, community, and nature.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain-running race in Bucovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two moderately difficult races, 12 km and 22 km, on routes consisting mainly of mountain trails, with sections through forest and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița ski slope, and the route reaches Diecilor Peak at an altitude of 1,301 meters. Participants should be prepared for nighttime mountain running and bring appropriate gear, including a headlamp and a mobile phone.

name: Harvest Run

The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and amateur or experienced runners. Participants enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with courses adapted for all ages and performance levels.

The event takes place on the streets of Brașov’s Tractorul district and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.

The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, forest roads and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy themselves and meet. The half-marathon distance and the other races are suitable for different levels of training, and the event includes hydration points and course marshals.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon

The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL

A verseny során a résztvevők Budapest legszebb, világörökségi helyszínei mentén futhatnak, miközben élvezhetik a város panorámáját és a hangulatos szurkolást. A fesztivál a futás ünnepe, ahol mindenki megtalálhatja a számára legmegfelelőbb távot az 5 km-től a maratonig. A rendezvényen egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a résztvevőket, emellett számos kísérőprogram és zenei élmény teszi felejthetetlenné a hétvégét.

The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.

The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. additional: The race is certified and awards 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series and 5 hours for others. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The organiser provides clear course marking and safety on the route. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

description: Račiansky kros – autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková dolina area of Bratislava-Rača. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere in the pleasant surroundings of the amphitheatre and nearby area. The organisers, OZ PERUN, ensure thorough preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Race in the natural surroundings of Knižková dolina
Start and finish at the Bratislava-Rača amphitheatre
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: The registration form and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organiser is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course is 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt. The races are open to men, women and children. Registration is available online and on-site, with a limited number of starting places. The event also includes children’s races and post-race refreshments.

location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou District. The race offers two main courses: 9 km with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain and a 4 km course. There is also a non-competitive Nordic Walking event. Men and women can compete in various age categories, and children have a separate start. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The main race starts at 13:00 and the children’s race at 11:00.
course_highlights: 9 km course with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain
4 km hobby course and non-competitive Nordic Walking event
Race at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec
additional: Children start at 11:00. Men’s and women’s categories are divided by age. Part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. The race takes place at the T1 Ring venue, with registration available online and on site. Entry fees range from €8 to €20. Race starts are at 11:00 and 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: The Košickopolianska Ten is a running event organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka and held in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka. The main race starts at 1:00 p.m., while the children’s categories begin at 11:00 a.m. The race is divided into several age categories for men, women, and children, welcoming runners of all ages. The organizers welcome everyone who wants to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural center in Košická Polianka
Several age categories for men, women, and children
The pleasant surroundings of the municipality of Košická Polianka
additional: The children’s races start at 11:00 a.m. Categories are divided by age, from age 0 through seniors. The event is organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka; contact phone numbers and email addresses are available for those seeking information. The race is part of a series of editions and offers the opportunity to take part in a 10 km race, with various categories for all age groups, including children’s races.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

description: Sninský Cross is a traditional running race held at the Amphitheatre of RO Rybníky in Snina. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course with official measurement, which follows a city circuit and passes through woodland. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a great atmosphere, refreshments, and medals for all participants. Winners in the men’s and women’s categories receive medals and prizes. The race is organized by the ZasRun running club, which also provides timing and results services.
course_highlights: 3 × 2 km city circuit in the square in Snina
The course passes through woodland to Zelený dvor and along the old road in the direction of Budimír
Asphalt surface; the course has an official certificate confirming its measured distance
additional: A changing room is available in a tent, toilets are at Hotel Kamei, and bag storage is in the tent by registration. Every competitor must wear their bib visibly on their chest; without it, their time will not be recorded. The winners will be announced immediately after all runners have finished, at the venue. The race is held according to the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race features three courses of different lengths and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All courses are well marked and pass through beautiful natural scenery. This event is more than just a race; it is a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a comprehensive race package and on-course support. The start is scheduled for October 31, 2026, with time limits tailored to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different lengths: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a race-logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, aid stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: A „Fuss egy napot!” egy ultrafutó esemény, amely a Benkó Zoltán Parkban kerül megrendezésre Kecskeméten. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a közösségi sportélmény megteremtése. A futók különböző távokon mérhetik össze erejüket egy barátságos és támogató környezetben. A program része a farsangi hangulat és a közös mozgás öröme.
course_highlights: Ultrafutás a Benkó domb környékén
Természetközeli, változatos terep
Közösségi és farsangi hangulat
additional: Az eseményen többféle távon lehet részt venni, a regisztráció határideje 2025. november 5., a helyszínen korlátozott lehetőségek vannak a ruházat és az eszközök cseréjére, valamint a tóhoz való hozzáférés nem biztosított futás közben.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: A Halloween Run 2026 egy különleges, izgalmas futóesemény Budapesten, a volt Kőbányai Sörgyár területén és pincerendszerében. A verseny során a résztvevők egy sötét, hátborzongató hangulatú pályán haladnak át, ahol rémalakok és ijesztő effektek kísérik őket. A futamok különböző távokon zajlanak, a rövid túráktól a hosszabb, több körös versenyekig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelőt. A verseny végén zene és ünneplés várja a bátor résztvevőket, akik végigküzdötték a kihívásokat.
course_highlights: Útvonal a volt Kőbányai Sörgyár területén és pincerendszerében
Sötét, hátborzongató látványvilág és ijesztő effektek
Változatos távok, köztük 21 km-es körverseny és alagútban futás
additional: A verseny helyszíne Budapest X. kerületében, a Rottenbiller Parkban található. Tömegközlekedéssel jól megközelíthető, parkolási lehetőség korlátozott. A versenyprogram több futamot tartalmaz, kezdve a 2,5 km-es Halloween túráktól a 21 km-es egyéni és váltó versenyig. A helyszínen nevezni legkésőbb a futam rajtja előtt 45 perccel lehet, amennyiben az online nevezés nem telt be. Az eredményhirdetés 15:40-kor kezdődik. Több futam, tematikus sötét hangulat, különböző távok, helyszín Budapest, Rottenbiller Park, online és helyszíni nevezés, eredményhirdetések.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: A Vaskapu Trail egy természetközeli terepfutó verseny Esztergomban, amely három különböző távon kínál kihívást a futóknak: 8 km, 16 km és 22 km. A verseny útvonala ösvényeken és kijelölt turistaútvonalakon halad, minimális közúti szakaszokkal, így a résztvevők élvezhetik a természet szépségeit és a változatos terepet. A rendezvény környezettudatos, pohármentes frissítőpontokkal és a Zöld Erdő program támogatásával. A rajt és cél a Vaskapu Étteremnél, a Brilli Gyula menedékháznál található, ahol a versenyzők kényelmes öltöző- és csomagtárolási lehetőséget is kapnak.
course_highlights: Terepfutás ösvényeken és kijelölt turistaútvonalakon
Három táv: 8 km, 16 km és 22 km, változatos nehézségi szintekkel
Minimális közúti szakasz, természetközeli élmény
additional: A verseny chipes időméréssel zajlik, a chipek 2000 Ft kaució ellenében vehetők át. A verseny pohármentes, ezért a résztvevőknek kulacsot vagy saját poharat kell hozniuk. A rajtcsomag átvétel a verseny napján a versenyközpontban történik, korábbi átvétel nincs. A nevezés lemondása 2026.10.15-ig lehetséges, utána csak a következő évre vihető át a nevezés. A versenyközpontban elkülönített női és férfi öltözők, valamint épített WC áll rendelkezésre, mosdó nincs. Minden teljesítő befutóérmet kap, az abszolút első három női és férfi helyezett külön díjazásban részesül. A versenyen kötelező a hidratáláshoz szükséges felszerelés, a helyszínen öltözők és csomagmegőrző szolgáltatások állnak rendelkezésre, valamint a résztvevők támogatására környezetbarát megoldások kerülnek alkalmazásra.
